title.en: 'Titan of Australian sport': Boxer Tony Mundine honoured at heartfelt Redfern memorial
title.zh: 澳大利亚体育界的“巨人”：拳击手托尼·蒙迪内在一场感人的雷德芬纪念仪式上受到表彰

summary.en: From boxing rings to Redfern's Block, Anthony 'Tony' Mundine's impact and memory remain unmatched.
summary.zh: 从拳击擂台到雷德芬的街区，安东尼·“托尼”·蒙迪内的影响和记忆依然无与伦比。

body.en:
WARNING: This article contains the name and image of an Aboriginal person who has passed away.

Respected Bundjalung boxer Anthony 'Tony' Mundine OAM has been remembered as an "unwavering anchor" of strength and determination at an emotional ceremony in Sydney's Redfern.

Crowds gathered at Redfern Oval on Saturday morning to pay their respects to Mundine, who died from a heart attack on 30 August — aged 75.

His coffin was carried to a small stage — decorated with a large bouquet and the Aboriginal flag proudly draped across the top.

On the side, the dark wood was printed with a pair of boxing gloves and a gold rabbit, a nod to Mundine's loyal, lifelong love of the South Sydney Rabbitohs.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Bundjalung and Gadigal man Craig Madden, nephew to "Uncle Tony", welcomed guests to Country.

He recalled the life of a man who, at 15, came to Sydney to chase his dreams "into the ring".

"Steady, loyal and always there when you needed him. He was strong and staunch, yet humble, kind and generous beyond measure," he said.

"He always made room for a yarn and a laugh, or a quiet word when someone needed comfort."

"He was not a man who wasted words; the ones he shared carried wisdom, warmth and strength ... he shared lessons about life that stayed with you —leaving you feeling hopeful, grounded and ready to face what was to come next."

He reflected on Mundine's "quiet resilience, unwavering integrity and deep strength of character" that saw him become a "titan of Australian sport".

Acknowledging the legend's achievements in the ring, Mundine Jr said his "greatest victory" was the establishment of the Elouera Tony Mundine Gym and the Tony Mundine Hostel.

"He built far more than physical places — he built sanctuaries of hope," said Mundine Jr.

"For generations of community and young people, especially Aboriginal youth seeking direction, safe housing or a second chance, Tony offered a home away from home."

A "steady anchor", Mundine was a "deeply devoted" family man and a "loyal and steadfast" friend.

"Your fight may be done, but your victories are eternal — and your legacy will never fade."

Mundine's four children, Kelly, Natalie, Anthony and Kiah, also paid tribute to their father.

His youngest child, Kiah Tony Mundine Atkins, described her father as "positive, friendly, kind and happy", a man who "loved people" and deeply loved his grandchildren.

She recalled his cheekiness, his pride in his bright red car he constantly washed, and his funny sayings, "stone the crows, and everybody was a cowboy".

"Whenever I would ask my Dad, 'How are you, Dad?' He would say, 'I'm cruising like a...
body.zh: 警告：本文包含已去世的原住民的姓名和图片。 受人尊敬的 Bundjalung 拳击手 Anthony 'Tony' Mundine OAM 在悉尼 Redfern 举行的激动人心的仪式上被人们铭记为力量和决心的“坚定不移的锚”。 周六早上，人群聚集在雷德芬椭圆形球场向 Mundine 致敬，Mundine 于 8 月 30 日因心脏病去世，享年 75 岁。 他的棺材被抬到一个小舞台上，舞台上装饰着一大束花，顶部骄傲地悬挂着原住民旗帜。 侧面，深色木料上印有一副拳击手套和一只金色兔子，以表达 Mundine 对南悉尼兔子队 (South Sydney Rabbitohs) 忠诚、终生的热爱。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 Bundjalung 和 Gadigal 人 Craig Madden（“托尼叔叔”的侄子）欢迎客人来到乡村。 他回忆起一名男子15岁时的生活，他来到悉尼“进入拳击场”追逐自己的梦想。 “稳定、忠诚，当你需要他时，他总是在你身边。他坚强、坚定，但又谦逊、善良和慷慨，”他说。 “当有人需要安慰时，他总是为一些故事和笑声或安静的话语腾出空间。” “他不是一个浪费言语的人；他分享的那些话充满了智慧、温暖和力量……他分享的人生教训会一直伴随着你——让你感到充满希望、脚踏实地，并准备好面对接下来的事情。” 他回顾了蒙丁“平静的韧性、坚定不移的正直和深厚的性格力量”，这些使他成为“澳大利亚体育的巨人”。 小蒙丁承认这位传奇人物在拳击场上取得的成就，他说他“最大的胜利”是建立了埃卢埃拉·托尼·蒙丁健身房和托尼·蒙丁旅馆。 小蒙丁说：“他建造的不仅仅是物质空间，他还建造了希望的庇护所。” “对于几代社区和年轻人，尤其是寻求方向、安全住房或第二次机会的原住民年轻人来说，托尼提供了一个家外之家。” 蒙丁是一位“稳定的锚”，是一位“深深奉献”的家庭男人和一位“忠诚而坚定”的朋友。 “你的战斗可能已经结束，但你的胜利是永恒的——你的遗产永远不会消失。” 蒙丁的四个孩子凯利、娜塔莉、安东尼和凯也向他们的父亲致敬。 他最小的孩子基亚·托尼·蒙丁·阿特金斯 (Kiah Tony Mundine Atkins) 形容她的父亲“积极、友善、善良、快乐”，是一个“爱人”并深爱自己的孙辈的人。 她回忆起他的厚颜无耻，他对自己经常清洗的鲜红色汽车的自豪，以及他有趣的说法，“用石头打乌鸦，每个人都是牛仔”。 “每当我问爸爸，‘爸爸，你好吗？’他会说，‘我就像一艘巡航船......

reflection.en: The passing of Anthony 'Tony' Mundine, a respected figure in Australian sport and community, reminds us of the universal human experience of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this reality, stating that 'man is destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.' His memorial service in Redfern, attended by many, reflects the deep impact he had and the...
reflection.zh: 备受尊敬的澳大利亚体育界和社区人士安东尼·“托尼”·蒙迪内（Anthony 'Tony' Mundine）的离世，提醒我们人类共同经历的必死性。希伯来书9:27谈到这一现实，指出“人人都有一死，死后且有审判”。他在雷德芬举行的追悼仪式，有众多人士参加，反映了他产生的深远影响，以及人们在生命和失落中所共同经历的旅程。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: The Coalition proposal that could make flag burning illegal in Australia
title.zh: 可能使焚烧国旗非法的联盟提案

summary.en: The Coalition in Australia is proposing legislation that would make burning the national flag a criminal offense, punishable by up to 12 months in jail. This is not the first attempt to ban flag burning, with at least eight previous failed legislative efforts. The proposal also includes penalties for desecrating war...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚联盟党正在提议立法，将焚烧国旗定为刑事犯罪，可处以最高12个月的监禁。这并非首次尝试禁止焚烧国旗，此前至少有八次立法努力均告失败。该提案还包括对亵渎战争纪念碑的处罚，反对党领袖否认此举是出于政治动机。

body.en:
Burning the Australian flag could lead to up to 12 months in jail under Opposition plans to be presented to parliament.

Opposition leader Angus Taylor on Sunday denied the proposal was aimed at warding off the threat of right-wing rival One Nation, which has soared above the Coalition in the polls.

Serious public desecration of the Australian flag, designed to incite hatred, would be a criminal offence punishable by a year in jail under the policy.

Those who deface, desecrate or destroy public war memorials would also face serious penalties under a new federal criminal offence.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Any criminal offences for such defacement are currently implemented under a patchwork of state and territory laws.

The policy would extend to damage to significant memorials commemorating Australia's history, like statues of Captain Cook.

Under the Coalition's proposal, 26 January would also be enshrined as Australia's national day, requiring future changes to be put to a plebiscite.

The defacing of memorials and the national flag is governed by state and territory laws, all with different penalties.

It is at least the eighth federal attempt in Australia's history for burning of the flag to be made illegal, all of which have previously failed.

Concerns have previously been raised about whether such a measure would stand up to a constitutional challenge.

Long-standing Liberal prime minister John Howard also opposed the measure, saying in 2006 that criminalising flag-burning would "only turn yahoo behaviour into martyrdom".

But Taylor insisted it was an important policy for protecting Australia's way of life, repeatedly denying the timing was due to One Nation's renewed appeal with voters.

"What I make of the situation right now is we've got to re-establish trust with the Australian people," he said.

"When I get out and talk to people, there are a lot of Australians who want us to go back to those core Liberal and National Party values."

Labor assistant minister Matt Thistlethwaite said the plan to criminalise flag-burning was alarmist and would restrict freedom of speech.

"I think that there's a bit of an element of desperation there, trying to chase One Nation and further to the right and to capture some of those votes," he said.

When asked if there were any circumstances in which the Liberals and Nationals would enter a coalition with One Nation to form government, Taylor said: "No."

His comments come from conflicting answers from other Coalition figures, some of whom left the door open to a possible future partnership.

The Liberals and Nationals have consistently lost ground to One Nation since the Coalition's bruising...
body.zh: 根据反对党向议会提交的计划，焚烧澳大利亚国旗可能会导致最高 12 个月的监禁。 反对党领袖安格斯·泰勒周日否认该提案旨在抵御右翼竞争对手一国党的威胁，该党在民意调查中的支持率飙升至联盟党之上。 根据该政策，严重公开亵渎澳大利亚国旗、旨在煽动仇恨的行为将构成刑事犯罪，可判处一年监禁。 根据一项新的联邦刑事罪，那些污损、亵渎或摧毁公共战争纪念馆的人也将面临严厉的处罚。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 目前，任何针对此类污损的刑事犯罪都是根据各州和领地的法律实施的。 该政策将扩大到对纪念澳大利亚历史的重要纪念碑的破坏，例如库克船长的雕像。 根据联盟党的提议，1 月 26 日也将被定为澳大利亚国庆日，要求未来的修改需通过公民投票进行。 污损纪念碑和国旗受各州和领地法律管辖，并有不同的处罚。 这至少是澳大利亚历史上第八次将焚烧国旗定为非法的联邦尝试，此前所有尝试均以失败告终。 此前有人担心这样的措施是否能经受住宪法挑战。 长期担任自由党首相的约翰·霍华德也反对这项措施，他在 2006 年表示，将焚烧国旗定为犯罪“只会将雅虎行为变成殉道者”。 但泰勒坚称这是保护澳大利亚生活方式的一项重要政策，并一再否认这一时机是由于一国党重新向选民发出呼吁。 “我对目前局势的看法是，我们必须与澳大利亚人民重新建立信任，”他说。 “当我出去与人们交谈时，很多澳大利亚人希望我们回到自由党和国家党的核心价值观。” 工党助理部长 Matt Thistlethwaite 表示，将焚烧国旗定为刑事犯罪的计划是危言耸听，并将限制言论自由。 他说：“我认为那里有一点绝望的成分，试图追赶一国党并进一步向右转并夺取一些选票。” 当被问及自由党和国家党是否会在任何情况下与一国党联合组建政府时，泰勒说：“不会。” 他的评论来自其他联盟人物相互矛盾的回答，其中一些人为未来可能的合作伙伴关系敞开了大门。 自从联盟党遭受重创以来，自由党和国家党一直输给一国党……

reflection.en: The debate over criminalizing flag burning in Australia touches on deeply held national sentiments and the expression of dissent. Proverbs 14:34 reminds us that 'righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a reproach to any people.' This suggests that a nation's true strength and honor are found not in enforcing reverence for symbols, but in upholding justice...
reflection.zh: 关于在澳大利亚将焚烧国旗定为刑事犯罪的辩论，触及了根深蒂固的国家情感和异议表达。《箴言》14章34节提醒我们：“行为正直的，国就得高；可恶的，民就受羞辱。”这表明，一个国家的真正力量和荣誉不在于强制人们崇敬象征，而在于其法律和行为中维护公正和道德诚信。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.

title.en: The wedding dress six women shared — and nobody can find
title.zh: 六位新娘共享的婚纱——如今却消失无踪

summary.en: A wedding dress, a symbol of union passed down through six brides over seventy years, has gone missing. The dress, originally worn by Maria in Sydney after arriving from Greece, was a cherished heirloom.
summary.zh: 一条象征结合的婚纱，在七十多年间由六位新娘传承，如今却不知所踪。这条婚纱最初由玛丽亚在从希腊抵达悉尼后穿着，是一件珍贵的传家宝。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Seventy years ago, two young Greek women arrived in Australia on the same ship, carrying hopes of a new life.

Their friendship began on a 38-day voyage from Athens to Sydney aboard the MS Tasmania, one of the ships that came to be known as "bride ships" — carrying thousands of young Greek women to Australia in the post-war years.

Ten days after arriving in Sydney, Maria wore a hastily bought wedding dress at a Sydney department store to marry Spiro Alexakis.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Now both great-grandmothers — yiayias — embrace warmly in Maria's living room in Padstow in Sydney's west.

"What are they doing to us?" Eleni exclaims with a cheeky, slightly exasperated grin.

The 92-year-old gestures to her son, George, and Maria's daughter Effy, who have brought them together to reminisce.

Chattering rapidly in Greek about how the years have passed, the two women sit at the dining table, which quickly fills with coffee cups, sweets, and a sprawling collection of black-and-white photos.

Dozens of images of their younger selves and old friends, at weddings, dancing and holding babies; snapshots of women starting new lives in Australia after leaving Greece.

Carefully, they pull out their stefana — Greek Orthodox wedding crowns — which they've both kept for 70 years.

"When they do this in the church," Eleni tells SBS News, holding her stefana and crossing her arms together.

Maria and Eleni's stories also offer a window into a little-known chapter of post-war Greek migration to Australia and the women who left behind family and familiarity, travelling thousands of kilometres to marry men they barely knew.

A closer look at the family photos revealed a surprising detail in a familiar story.

Maria's daughter Effy, a renowned photographer who has spent her career documenting Greek Australian migrant stories with her partner, historian Leonard Janiszewski, discovered wedding photos of different women wearing the same dress.

"I love nothing more than going through photos, especially our old family photos," Effy tells SBS News.

"I was going through these with my mum … and I saw there were two or three photos of brides wearing a similar dress.

"And mum said, 'Oh, yes, we all wore the same dress' and I thought, 'Oh, I had no idea'."

That discovery prompted Effy to trace the dress through photographs, family memories, and other records.

After two years of research, she managed to track down four other women who wore the same dress.

Neither woman remembers where the dress was bought. They do know...
body.zh: 分享您的反馈并帮助我们改进此功能。请在此处详细了解我们如何在 SBS 使用人工智能。 七十年前，两名年轻的希腊妇女带着对新生活的希望同船抵达澳大利亚。 他们的友谊始于乘坐塔斯马尼亚号从雅典到悉尼的 38 天航行，这艘船后来被称为“新娘船”，在战后载着数千名年轻的希腊妇女前往澳大利亚。 抵达悉尼十天后，玛丽亚穿着匆忙购买的婚纱在悉尼一家百货公司与斯皮罗·阿莱克萨基斯结婚。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 现在，两位曾祖母（yiayias）在悉尼西部帕兹托玛丽亚的客厅里热烈拥抱。 “他们想对我们做什么？”艾莱妮带着厚颜无耻、略显恼怒的笑容惊呼道。 这位 92 岁的老人向她的儿子乔治和玛丽亚的女儿艾菲做了个手势，他们让他们聚在一起回忆往事。 两位女士坐在餐桌旁，用希腊语快速地谈论着这些年的过去，餐桌上很快就摆满了咖啡杯、糖果和一大堆黑白照片。 数十张他们年轻时的自己和老朋友在婚礼上、跳舞和抱着婴儿的照片；妇女离开希腊后在澳大利亚开始新生活的快照。 他们小心翼翼地拿出他们的 Stefana（希腊东正教婚礼王冠），这顶王冠他们都保存了 70 年。 “当他们在教堂里这样做时，”埃莱妮告诉 SBS 新闻，她抱着她的斯特凡娜，双臂交叉在一起。 玛丽亚和埃莱妮的故事还提供了一个窗口，让我们了解战后希腊移民到澳大利亚的鲜为人知的一章，以及那些抛下家人和熟悉的女性，长途跋涉数千公里嫁给她们几乎不认识的男人的故事。 仔细观察这些家庭照片，我们发现了一个熟悉的故事中令人惊讶的细节。 玛丽亚的女儿艾菲 (Effy) 是一位著名摄影师，她的职业生涯一直与她的伴侣、历史学家伦纳德·贾尼舍夫斯基 (Leonard Janiszewski) 一起记录希腊裔澳大利亚移民的故事，她发现了不同女性穿着同一件衣服的结婚照。 “我最喜欢翻看照片，尤其是我们的家庭旧照片，”艾菲告诉 SBS 新闻。 “我和妈妈一起浏览这些……我看到有两三张新娘穿着类似裙子的照片。 “妈妈说，‘哦，是的，我们都穿同样的衣服’，我想，‘哦，我不知道’。” 这一发现促使艾菲通过照片、家庭记忆和其他记录来追踪这件衣服。 经过两年的研究，她成功找到了另外四名穿着同样衣服的女性。 两位女士都不记得这件衣服是在哪里买的。他们确实知道...

reflection.en: The disappearance of the wedding dress is a poignant reminder of how material objects can be lost, yet the stories and commitments they represent endure. This heirloom, worn by six brides, speaks to the lasting power of marriage vows and the deep human desire for connection and continuity across generations.
reflection.zh: 婚纱的失踪令人伤感，它提醒我们物质物品会消失，但它们所代表的故事和承诺却会永存。这件由六位新娘传承下来的传家宝，诉说着婚姻誓言的持久力量，以及人类跨越世代寻求联结与延续的深切渴望。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: Where's the snow? Could 2026 be Australia's worst season?
title.zh: 雪在哪里？2026年将是澳大利亚最糟糕的季节吗？

summary.en: Ski resorts across Australia are closing early as snow depth reaches a record low, with the Snowy Mountains' Spencers Creek recording its third-lowest peak depth since 1954.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的滑雪胜地因降雪量达到创纪录的低点而提前关闭，斯宾塞溪的降雪量自1954年以来达到第三低的峰值。

body.en:
Australian ski resorts are being forced to close a month early due to record-low snow depth.

Snowy Mountain's Spencers Creek hit a historic Australian low, recording a snow depth of 31.2 centimetres on 3 September.

The peak depth was 94.5cm on 13 August — the third lowest depth recorded in the region since 1954.

On average, peak depth is recorded in the first weeks of September. From the 1950s to the 1970s, the average depth in the first week of September was just over 180 centimetres — compared to the 120cm average from 2020 to 2025.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Deep Creek registered record-high snow depths of over 200cm in 1964 and 1981, while Three Mile Dam had record-highs just over 100cm in 1956 and 1995.

The 2026 ski season was the shortest on record, with five of Australia's ski resorts already shutting the slopes.

Victoria's Mount Baw Baw and Selwyn Snow Resort in NSW closed operations before the end of August — with Mt Hotham, Falls Creek and Charlotte Pass closing over the weekend.

Only three of the eight mainland ski resorts in Australia remain open — Perisher, Thredbo and Mount Buller.

Ski season's premature end can be chalked up to the winter warmth and a lack of snow-bearing cold fronts.

The unusual winter warmth can be attributed to a multitude of weather behaviours, including El Niño, above-average sea surface temperatures, limited cold air in frontal systems and the ongoing impacts of climate change.

Australian Climate Council councillor and meteorologist Dr Andrew Watkins told SBS News in May it would be a warm winter.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 由于积雪深度创历史新低，澳大利亚滑雪胜地被迫提前一个月关闭。 9 月 3 日，雪山的 Spencers Creek 降雪深度达到澳大利亚历史最低点，达到 31.2 厘米。 8 月 13 日的峰值深度为 94.5 厘米，这是该地区自 1954 年以来有记录的第三低深度。 平均而言，峰值深度出现在九月的第一周。从 20 世纪 50 年代到 1970 年代，9 月第一周的平均深度略高于 180 厘米，而 2020 年到 2025 年的平均深度为 120 厘米。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 深溪在 1964 年和 1981 年创下了超过 200 厘米的历史最高积雪深度，而三英里大坝在 1956 年和 1995 年创下了略高于 100 厘米的历史最高积雪深度。 2026 年的滑雪季节是有记录以来最短的，澳大利亚的五个滑雪胜地已经关闭了滑雪场。 新南威尔士州维多利亚州的 Mount Baw Baw 和 Selwyn 滑雪度假村已于 8 月底前关闭，霍瑟姆山 (Mt Hotham)、福尔斯克里克 (Falls Creek) 和夏洛特山口 (Charlotte Pass) 也在周末关闭。 澳大利亚八个大陆滑雪胜地中只有三个仍然开放：Perisher、Thredbo 和 Mount Buller。 滑雪季节的提前结束可以归因于冬季温暖和缺乏带雪的冷锋。 冬季异常温暖可归因于多种天气行为，包括厄尔尼诺现象、高于平均水平的海面温度、锋面系统冷空气有限以及气候变化的持续影响。 澳大利亚气候委员会委员兼气象学家安德鲁·沃特金斯博士在五月告诉 SBS 新闻，这将是一个温暖的冬天。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The news from Australia's ski fields paints a stark picture of environmental change impacting livelihoods. Even when the usual abundance of winter is absent, and the land yields little, there remains a call to find joy and steadfastness. This season's scarcity reminds us that our ultimate hope is not in predictable seasons, but in the enduring faithfulness...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚滑雪场的新闻描绘了一幅严峻的环境变化影响生计的图景。即使在冬季的丰饶不再、土地产量甚少之时，仍有呼召去寻找喜乐和坚定。这个季节的匮乏提醒我们，我们最终的盼望不在于可预测的季节，而在于雅伟永恒的信实。

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

This situation underscores the importance of careful planning and seeking wise counsel when implementing new policies, as even well-intentioned systems can falter without adequate...

summary.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) reported detecting three instances of large dogs not being securely leashed in public during recent operations. These special inspections, conducted on August 30th and the weekend, aim to increase owner awareness of responsible pet ownership and reduce dog...
summary.zh: 渔业、农业及渔业署（渔护署）表示，在最近的行动中，发现三宗涉及大型犬只在公众地方未被妥善繫上牵绳的疑似个案。该署于8月30日（星期六及日）进行了特别巡查及执法行动，旨在提高狗主在公众地方妥善管束其犬只的意识，并减少因管束不当而引致的犬只袭击事件。

body.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) said it detected three suspected cases where large dogs were not being securely held on a leash in public places during recent operations. The AFCD said special inspection and enforcement operations were held around town on August 30, Saturday and Sunday. The department said officers will follow up on the suspected violations and launch prosecutions accordingly. "The special operation aimed to raise awareness among dog keepers to properly control their dogs in public places and to reduce incidents of dog attacks arising from improper control, while promoting the message of responsible pet ownership and explaining relevant statutory requirements to members of the public," an AFCD spokesman said. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 渔农自然护理署（渔护署）表示，近期行动中发现三宗怀疑大型犬只在公众地方没有用皮带安全拴住的个案。渔护署表示，8月30日、周六和周日在全市范围内开展了专项检查和执法行动。该部门表示，警方将跟进涉嫌违规行为并提出检控。渔护署发言人表示：「是次特别行动旨在提高养狗人士在公众地方妥善管控狗只的意识，减少因管控不当而引发的狗只袭击事件，同时向公众宣传负责任饲养宠物的信息，并解释相关法例规定。」埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The AFCD's operations underscore the importance of responsible stewardship, even in the care of pets. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.' This principle extends to how we manage our responsibilities, ensuring the safety and well-being of the community through diligent care and adherence to regulations.
reflection.zh: 渔护署的行动强调了负责任的管理的重要性，即使是对待宠物。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行”。这一原则延伸到我们如何履行自己的责任，通过勤勉的照料和遵守规定来确保社区的安全和福祉。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: ‘A victim’: American Bully dies in surgery, owners question fighting dog rules
title.zh: “受害者”：美国恶霸犬手术中死亡，主人质疑斗牛犬规定

summary.en: The owners of an American Bully are challenging the authorities’ classification of “fighting dogs” after their pet, a breed strictly controlled in Hong Kong, died during neutering, a procedure they undertook amid a crackdown on non-compliance. title.en: Horse racing boosts mega event economy: CE
title.zh: 赛马提振大型活动经济：行政长官

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee has praised horse racing as a distinctive cultural emblem of Hong Kong and a significant catalyst for the city's mega-event economy. Speaking at the Sha Tin Racecourse on Sunday during a ceremony to launch the new racing season and award the Chief Executive's Cup, Lee noted the event's success...
summary.zh: 行政长官李家超称赞赛马是香港独特的文化象征，也是推动本港大型活动经济的关键动力。他周日在沙田马场出席新赛马季启动仪式并颁发行政长官杯。李家超在脸书发文表示，新赛马季开锣吸引了本地赛马爱好者和访客。他还指出，上个赛马季内地和海外游客激增，证明了政府推广赛马旅游的努力取得成效，吸引了超过40万名内地和海外游客到沙田和跑马地...

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee has hailed horse racing as a unique cultural symbol of Hong Kong and a key driver to the city’s mega event economy. He was at Sha Tin Racecourse on Sunday to attend a ceremony ushering in new racing season and present the trophy for the Chief Executive's Cup. Writing in a Facebook post, Lee said the season opener attracted both local racing fans and visitors. He also said a surge in mainland and overseas tourists in the last racing season demonstrated the results of government’s efforts to promote horse racing tourism. “In the last season, more than 400,000 mainland and overseas tourists were drawn to the Sha Tin and Happy Valley racecourses, doubling the figure from the previous season,” Lee said. “This not only demonstrated the strong appeal of the racecourse experience – which combines top-class racing with dining and entertainment – to global travellers, but also reflected the results of the government’s efforts to promote horse racing tourism since it was set out in the 2024 Policy Address.” Lee added that the SAR government will continue to attract tourists through mega events. Some tourists said they came to the Sha Tin Racecourse to support "Ka Ying Rising" – one of the world's top sprinters and the winner of the Chief Executive's Cup. "I've heard it's the greatest sprinter, that's what I've been told back at home and was told that 'Ka Ying Rising' is the one horse to come and see and we were fortunate to be here on opening weekend and we had very good time with that," said Sophia, a tourist from Sydney. "We're going to The Everest which is next month and we know that 'Ka Ying Rising' will also be racing there. So very excited to see 'Ka Ying Rising' both here in Sha Tin and both back home in Sydney," another tourist Ethan said. "Ka Ying Rising", under the saddle of Australian ace Zac Purton and trained by David Hayes, blew away the field in the 1,200-metre Chief Executive's Cup in a devastating time of 1min 6.11secs, setting a new course record. This was also its 21st straight win. Also on Sunday, a number of local horses were looking to make their presence felt on the world stage but came up short. "Fast Network" was a disappointing 15th in the Centaur Stakes at Hanshin Racecourse in Japan, while three Hong Kong entries – "Gorgeous Win", "Self Improvement" and "Beauty Waves" – also finished unplaced at the Korea Sprint in Seoul. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 行政长官李家超称赞赛马是香港独特的文化象征，也是香港大型赛事经济的关键驱动力。他周日在沙田马场出席新赛季开幕典礼并颁发行政长官杯奖杯。李在脸书帖子中写道，赛季揭幕战吸引了当地赛车迷和游客。他又表示，上个赛马季内地及海外游客激增，体现了政府推动赛马旅游业的成果。李说：“上个赛季，沙田和跑马地马场吸引了超过40万名内地和海外游客，比上个赛季增加了一倍。” “这不仅展现了集顶级赛马与餐饮娱乐于一体的赛马场体验对全球旅客的强大吸引力，也体现了政府自2024年施政报告提出以来推动赛马旅游的成果。”李补充说，特区政府将继续以大型活动吸引游客。有游客表示，来到沙田马场是为了支持世界顶尖短跑选手、行政长官杯冠军“嘉英新星”。来自悉尼的游客索菲亚 (Sophia) 说：“我听说它是​​最伟大的短跑运动员，这就是我在家里被告知的，并被告知‘嘉英崛起’是一匹值得来看的马，我们很幸运能在开幕周末来到这里，度过了一段愉快的时光。” “我们下个月要去珠穆朗玛峰，我们知道‘嘉英崛起’也将在那里比赛。很高兴看到‘嘉英崛起’在沙田和悉尼的家乡，”另一位游客伊森说。 “嘉英崛起”在澳大利亚王牌Zac Purton的带领下，在David Hayes的训练下，在1,200米行政长官杯比赛中以1分6.11秒的毁灭性成绩横扫全场，创造了新的赛程纪录。这也是其连续21场胜利。同样在周日，一些当地的马匹希望在世界舞台上展现自己的存在，但未能实现。 「Fast Network」在日本阪神赛马场举行的 Centaur Stakes 中仅获得第 15 名，令人失望，而三支香港参赛作品「Gorgeous Win」、「Self Improvement」和「Beauty Waves」在首尔的韩国冲刺赛上也没有获得名次。埃德蒙·方编辑

The focus should remain on the well-being and fair treatment of the...

title.en: Chinese guitar capital’s stairway to export heaven
title.zh: 中国吉他之都的出口天堂之路

summary.en: The town of Zheng'an in China's Guizhou province has become a global center for guitar manufacturing, producing one in seven of the world's guitars. A decade ago, the industry did not exist, but now giant guitar sculptures and murals signify its dominance in the local landscape.
summary.zh: 中国贵州省的郑安县已成为全球吉他制造中心，生产了全球七分之一的吉他。十年前，这里还没有这个产业，但如今巨大的吉他雕塑和壁画标志着它在当地景观中的主导地位。

body.en: It doesn’t take long to guess the main industry of the Chinese town of Zheng’an. A giant guitar sculpture dominates the central square, guitar murals adorn walls and pavements and even the rubbish bins are shaped like guitars. This photo taken on July 27, 2026 shows a worker making a guitar at a guitar workshop in Zheng’an, in southwestern China’s Guizhou Province. Photo: Jade Gao/AFP. This corner of the southwest province of Guizhou produces one in every seven of the instruments sold worldwide. A decade ago, it had no guitar-making industry to speak of at all. There are hundreds of specialised manufacturing towns in China, producing items ranging from bicycles to socks. But the speed and scale of Zheng’an’s rise make it an example of the impact of China’s industrial strategy when a combination of local and central government investment is deployed to maximise favourable local conditions. For years, the town’s working-age residents left to find employment in factories in Guangdong, southern China’s manufacturing hub. Among them was Zheng Chuanjiu, who eventually started his own guitar-making business in the provincial capital Guangzhou. “The company was doing pretty well at that time and most of our staff in Guangzhou were also our fellow villagers from Zheng’an,” the founder of Shenqu Guitar told AFP. Embed from Getty Images In 2012, Zheng’an local authorities rolled out an initiative called “return the phoenix to the nest”, to encourage skilled migrant workers to return home and start businesses. “The county officials reached out to us. They wanted us to come back and develop the industry,” Zheng said. Shenqu became the first guitar manufacturer to settle in Zheng’an’s new economic zone. “After I’d been working here for a few years, many friends saw how well I was doing and came here to join me to develop the industry,” he said. When AFP visited Shenqu in July, rows upon rows of finished guitars sat neatly on racks, awaiting final tuning checks before shipment. “Why go far away to work when home is the best place?” a banner in the factory read. Natural advantages Within around 10 years, 87 home‑grown brands had emerged from the industrial cluster. Embed from Getty Images Authorities enticed companies with comprehensive financial, tax and employment support packages — some were offered three‑year tax exemptions and 10 years of free rent. Importantly though, Zheng’an has natural advantages in its favour. The area’s climate is perfect for guitar-making, according to master luthier Zhang Weiyi, who relocated his business from Guangzhou in 2019. “Whether the industry is big or small,...
body.zh: 不用多久就可以猜出中国正安小镇的主要产业。中央广场上矗立着巨大的吉他雕塑，墙壁和人行道上装饰着吉他壁画，甚至垃圾桶的形状也像吉他。这张照片拍摄于 2026 年 7 月 27 日，中国西南部贵州省正安市的一个吉他作坊里，一名工人正在制作吉他。照片：Jade Gau/法新社。全球销售的乐器中，七分之一的乐器都产自贵州省西南部的这个角落。十年前，它根本没有吉他制造行业可言。中国有数百个专业制造城镇，生产从自行车到袜子等各种产品。但正安崛起的速度和规模使其成为中国产业战略影响的一个例子，该战略将地方和中央政府投资结合起来，最大限度地发挥当地的有利条件。多年来，该镇的劳动年龄居民纷纷离开，前往中国南方制造业中心广东的工厂寻找工作。其中包括郑传九，他最终在省会广州开始了自己的吉他制作业务。神曲吉他创始人告诉法新社：“当时公司经营得很好，我们在广州的大部分员工也是正安的老乡。” 2012年，正安当地政府推出了一项名为“凤凰还巢”的举措，鼓励熟练农民工返乡创业。 “县政府官员联系了我们。他们希望我们回来发展这个行业，”郑说。神曲成为第一家落户正安新经济区的吉他制造商。 “我在这里工作几年后，很多朋友看到我做得很好，就来这里和我一起发展这个行业，”他说。法新社7月访问神曲时，一排排成品吉他整齐地摆放在架子上，等待装运前的最后调音检查。 “既然家是最好的地方，为什么还要去很远的地方工作呢？”工厂里的横幅上写着。天然优势 近10年间，产业集群涌现出87个本土品牌。当局以全面的财务、税收和就业支持计划来吸引企业——其中一些企业获得了三年免税和十年免租的优惠。但重要的是，正安有着天然的优势。该地区的气候非常适合吉他制作，制琴大师张伟一于 2019 年将自己的生意从广州搬迁到这里。“无论这个行业是大还是小，...

title.en: China artists quit S.Korea art show after organisers let ‘Taiwan’ be used in name of exhibition
title.zh: 中国艺术家因“台湾”参展名称退出韩国艺术展

summary.en: Chinese artists have withdrawn from a major South Korean art exhibition, the Gwangju Biennale, after organizers allowed the name "Taiwan" to be used in an exhibition title. This action has drawn criticism from China and highlights the ongoing political sensitivities surrounding cross-strait relations.
summary.zh: 中国艺术家已退出韩国光州双年展，原因是组织者允许在一场展览的名称中使用“台湾”一词。此举引发了中国的批评，并凸显了海峡两岸关系中持续存在的政治敏感性。

body.en: Chinese artists withdrew from a major South Korean art show after organisers allowed “Taiwan” to be used in the name of an exhibition, officials said Thursday, as China issued a rebuke. Gwangju Biennale. Photo: Gwangju Biennale. The Gwangju Biennale, one of Asia’s largest contemporary art events, is due to open Saturday, with its Pavilion Project bringing together artists from around the world at venues across the southwestern city. The dispute began after Taiwanese artists said organisers had initially agreed to call their exhibition the “Taiwan Pavilion”, but changed the name in June to “NTMoFA”, the acronym for Taiwan’s National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts. The change was made “without the consent of the participating team, and brutally erased Taiwan from the poster,” the artists said in a joint statement last month, accusing organisers of “political censorship”. China insists Taiwan is part of its territory and has threatened to use force to annex the self-ruled island of more than 23 million people. Last week, the Gwangju Biennale foundation reversed course and agreed to restore the name “Taiwan Pavilion”. Chinese artists then halted preparations for their own pavilion, and on Thursday, the Chinese artists announced they would formally withdraw, according to local media footage. A spokesperson for the foundation told AFP: “We have confirmation the Chinese artists are withdrawing from the biennale.” China’s consulate general in Gwangju said Biennale organisers “openly allowed the Taiwan region of China to participate in the exhibition using a name that is completely inconsistent with its status.” “This constitutes a serious violation of the One China principle,” it said, adding: “We once again urge the organisers of the Gwangju Biennale to immediately rectify their wrongdoing.” South Korea’s foreign ministry spoke up to calm the row, saying that the “government’s basic position regarding Taiwan remains unchanged”. Taiwan’s flag. Photo: Walid Berrazeg/HKFP. The ministry said the decision was made in the cultural and artistic sphere, and “is unrelated to the South Korean government’s position regarding Taiwan.” “We hope that this issue will not affect South Korea-China relations or exchanges and cooperation between the two countries,” they added.
body.zh: 官员周四表示，在组织者允许在展览名称中使用“台湾”一词后，中国艺术家退出了韩国的一场大型艺术展，中国对此予以谴责。光州双年展。照片：光州双年展。亚洲最大的当代艺术活动之一光州双年展将于周六开幕，其展馆项目将来自世界各地的艺术家聚集在这座西南部城市的各个场馆。争议始于台湾艺术家表示，主办方最初同意将他们的展览命名为“台湾馆”，但在六月将其名称改为“NTMoFA”，即台湾国立台湾美术馆的缩写。艺术家们在上个月的一份联合声明中表示，这一改变是“未经参赛团队同意的，并且残酷地将台湾从海报上抹掉”，并指责组织者进行“政治审查”。中国坚称台湾是其领土的一部分，并威胁要使用武力吞并这个拥有超过 2300 万人口的自治岛屿。上周，光州双年展基金会改变立场，同意恢复“台湾馆”名称。据当地媒体报道，中国艺术家随后停止了自己展馆的准备工作，周四，中国艺术家宣布正式退出。该基金会的发言人告诉法新社：“我们已确认中国艺术家将退出双年展。”中国驻光州总领事馆表示，双年展组织者“公然允许中国台湾地区使用与其地位完全不符的名称参加展览”。 “这严重违反了一个中国原则，”声明称，并补充说：“我们再次敦促光州双年展的组织者立即纠正错误行为。”韩国外交部发声平息争端，称“政府对台湾的基本立场没有改变”。台湾的国旗。照片：Walid Berrazeg/HKFP。韩国文化部表示，这一决定是在文化艺术领域做出的，“与韩国政府对台湾的立场无关”。他们补充说：“我们希望这个问题不会影响韩中关系或两国之间的交流与合作。”

reflection.en: The Gwangju Biennale dispute, where Chinese artists withdrew over the naming of a Taiwanese exhibition, illustrates how political sensitivities can disrupt cultural exchange. The desire for peace and harmonious relations, as urged in Romans 12:18, is challenged when nationalistic sentiments lead to withdrawal rather than dialogue.
reflection.zh: 光州双年展的争端，中国艺术家因台湾展览的命名问题而退出，说明了政治敏感性如何扰乱文化交流。罗马书12章18节所敦促的和平与和谐关系之愿望，在民族主义情绪导致退出而非对话时受到挑战。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...

title.en: Extreme pressure turns blue pigment into record-long single-atom copper chains
title.zh: 极端压力将蓝色颜料转化为创纪录的单原子铜链

summary.en: Scientists have created some of the longest single-atom copper chains to date, using a blue pigment (copper phthalocyanine) and extreme pressure. These chains could potentially serve as molecular wires, offering a path beyond the physical limits of traditional silicon-based electronics as technology continues to...
summary.zh: 科学家利用一种蓝色颜料（酞菁铜）和极端压力，创造了迄今为止最长的单原子铜链之一。这些链条有可能作为分子导线，为不断缩小的技术提供超越传统硅基电子物理极限的途径。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

As the electronics in our technology keep shrinking, traditional silicon-based chips are approaching their fundamental physical limits. Yet the wires connecting them might be able to shrink beyond conventional dimensions, as scientists have created one of the longest single-atom copper chains to date that could serve as molecular wires.

The researchers began with copper phthalocyanine (CuPc), a compound used to make the commonly used blue pigment phthalo blue. Under high pressure—more than 21 gigapascals, roughly 200,000 times normal atmospheric pressure—they converted the CuPc crystals into copper atomic chains stretching for micrometers, each encased in a carbon sheath.

The resulting sheathed single-metal-atom chains (sSMACs) resembled a household power cord on an atomic scale, with three distinct layers. The wires exhibited strong anisotropy, meaning electricity flows easily along the wire but has a hard time traveling sideways across it.

With more than 4,000 copper atoms strung into a single chain, the structure was two to three orders of magnitude longer than any single-atom chain made before. The previous record stood at just 28 atoms.

The 1D SMACs, considered the thinnest possible metal wires, are gaining attention because of their unusual electronic, magnetic and catalytic properties. Beyond their applications, these structures also give scientists a way to study how matter behaves at the smallest scales.

Scientists have successfully created single-atom chains before, but the method has been highly impractical for making longer ones. SMACs are traditionally grown in liquid solutions containing ligands—chemical wrappers that support the metal atoms. The trouble begins when the chains get longer and the wrappers needed to stabilize them become insoluble in the liquid.

This brings the synthesis to a halt, resulting in atomic wires that are fewer than 10 atoms long, a problem encountered in almost all previously made SMACs.

The researchers overcame these limitations by eliminating the liquids entirely and using a high-pressure solid-state reaction. They started with copper phthalocyanine, whose flat, ring-like molecules, each containing a single copper atom, naturally stacked one above another like a column of coins.

They placed the pigment crystals inside a tiny, high-pressure device called a diamond anvil cell, which triggered the transformation inside the solid material.

The copper atoms were pushed incredibly close together, while the outer carbon rings of adjacent pigment molecules fused to form a tough, diamond-like carbon tube around the copper core....
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 随着我们技术中的电子器件不断缩小，传统的硅基芯片正在接近其基本物理极限。然而，连接它们的电线可能能够缩小到超出常规尺寸，因为科学家们已经创造出了迄今为止最长的单原子铜链之一，可以用作分子电线。 研究人员从铜酞菁 (CuPc) 开始，这是一种用于制造常用蓝色颜料酞菁蓝的化合物。在高压下——超过 21 吉帕，大约是正常大气压的 200,000 倍——他们将 CuPc 晶体转化为延伸数微米的铜原子链，每个原子链都包裹在碳鞘中。 由此产生的带鞘单金属原子链（sSMAC）在原子尺度上类似于家用电源线，具有三个不同的层。这些电线表现出很强的各向异性，这意味着电流很容易沿着电线流动，但很难横向穿过它。 该结构由 4000 多个铜原子串成一条链，比以前制造的任何单原子链长两到三个数量级。之前的记录仅为 28 个原子。 一维 SMAC 被认为是最薄的金属线，由于其不寻常的电子、磁性和催化特性而受到关注。除了它们的应用之外，这些结构还为科学家提供了一种研究物质在最小尺度上如何行为的方法。 科学家们之前已经成功地创造了单原子链，但这种方法对于制造更长的原子链来说非常不切实际。 SMAC 传统上是在含有配体（支撑金属原子的化学包装物）的液体溶液中生长的。当链条变长并且稳定它们所需的包装纸变得不溶于液体时，问题就开始了。 这使得合成停止，导致原子线长度不足 10 个原子，这是几乎所有以前制造的 SMAC 都会遇到的问题。 研究人员通过完全消除液体并使用高压固态反应克服了这些限制。他们从铜酞菁开始，其扁平的环状分子，每个分子都含有一个铜原子，自然地一个一个堆叠在一起，就像一列硬币一样。 他们将颜料晶体放入一个称为金刚石砧室的微小高压装置中，从而引发固体材料内部的转变。 铜原子被极其紧密地推在一起，而相邻颜料分子的外碳环融合在一起，在铜核周围形成坚韧的、类金刚石碳管……

reflection.en: The pursuit of ever-smaller electronics pushes human ingenuity to explore the fundamental properties of matter. In this case, a common blue pigment, under immense pressure, reveals a new potential for conductivity. It is a reminder that the created world, from the grandest star to the smallest atom, holds wonders and possibilities that invite our careful...
reflection.zh: 对日益微小的电子产品的追求，推动着人类的智慧去探索物质的基本性质。在这种情况下，一种常见的蓝色颜料在巨大压力下，展现出新的导电潜力。这提醒我们，被造的世界，从最宏伟的星辰到最小的原子，都蕴藏着邀请我们仔细研究和敬畏的奇迹与可能性。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

Isar Aerospace said on Sunday that it would rapidly ⁠expand satellite deployments after the ⁠first orbital launch of ​its uncrewed Spectrum rocket from Arctic Norway, marking a ⁠breakthrough for a region where several countries are seeking a foothold in the fast-growing market for satellite launches. Continue reading...

As this venture embarks on its ambitious journey, it reminds us of the importance of entrusting our endeavors to a higher power, seeking wisdom and blessing in every step of our work. May this achievement inspire a spirit of hopeful innovation,...
reflection.zh: Isar Aerospace的Spectrum火箭成功发射，是人类智慧和勤奋规划的证明。当这项事业踏上雄心勃勃的征程时，它提醒我们，将我们的努力托付给更高的力量，并在我们工作的每一步中寻求智慧和祝福是多么重要。愿这一成就激发一种充满希望的创新精神，并认识到当我们致力于神圣的指引时，才能找到真正的成功。

title.en: How algorithms are making our environments bland
title.zh: 算法如何让我们的环境变得单调乏味

summary.en: The Pantone color of the year for 2026 is white, named Cloud Dancer. This choice signifies a growing trend towards a less colorful visual world, mirroring the observation that cookie-cutter developments are replacing areas with distinct character, such as the transformation of London's Elephant and Castle.
summary.zh: 2026年的潘通年度代表色是白色，名为“云舞者”。这一选择标志着我们的视觉世界正日益趋向色彩的减少，这与人们观察到的千篇一律的开发项目正在取代具有独特风貌的地区（例如伦敦的象与城堡区）的现象相呼应。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The Pantone color of the year for 2026 is white. It's called Cloud Dancer, which is described as a "lofty white." This choice reflects a growing trend away from color in our visual world.

You might have noticed this yourself . Where an area once had a distinct sense of place, we are seeing more cookie-cutter developments popping up. Take the London borough of Elephant and Castle, which has seen billions of pounds of development in recent years. The area has gone from a Latin American enclave full of distinct and varied buildings to what Oli Mould, a professor of social, cultural and historical geography, has warned is an "identikit homogeneous gentrified place" that risks "destroying the very thing that makes a community thriving and beautiful in the first place."

There is a similar increasing sense of uniformity and sameness in urban design around the world. In 1993, architect Rem Koolhaas traveled 360,000 km (224,000 miles) around the world, observing the rationalization of urban design (the movement toward efficiency rather than creativity in the process) through what he termed the " generic city ." Functional, efficient but colorless.

This trajectory toward blandness is reinforced and sustained by the increasing tendency to allow algorithms to mediate the choices we make . This has the effect of training perspectives to converge in " a strong pull toward sameness ."

Algorithms make predictions based on our choices, from music to home furnishings. The algorithm takes that choice and suggests similar products based on it, ultimately reinforcing and producing a monotonous and generic aesthetic taste. For instance, if you like a pop song by Sabrina Carpenter, you will then be served many songs exactly like it until your Spotify Wrapped says you are among the top listeners of something Spotify has bafflingly called " Pink Pilates Princess Strut Pop ."

These sorts of algorithms, in turn, reinforce the production of products to meet those generic tastes, ultimately flattening the diversity of creative work in everything from the songs we listen to to the urban surroundings in which we live.
