Algorithmically driven taste results in a monoculture where art, pets and everything in between are chosen to match the generic palette of an algorithmic world.

This generic algorithmic taste is also having an impact at the design stage ,...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 2026 年潘通年度颜色是白色。它的名字叫云舞，被形容为“高高在上的白色”。这种选择反映了我们视觉世界中远离色彩的日益增长的趋势。 您自己可能已经注意到这一点。在一个曾经具有独特地方感的地区，我们看到更多千篇一律的开发项目不断涌现。以伦敦大象城堡区为例，该区近年来的开发投资达数十亿英镑。该地区已经从充满独特和多样化建筑的拉丁美洲飞地变成了社会、文化和历史地理学教授奥利·莫尔德所警告的“千篇一律的中产阶级化地方”，这有可能“破坏最初使社区繁荣和美丽的东西”。 世界各地的城市设计都出现了类似的日益统一和雷同的感觉。 1993 年，建筑师雷姆·库哈斯环游世界 360,000 公里（224,000 英里），通过他所谓的“通用城市”观察城市设计的合理化（过程中向效率而非创造力的转变）。实用、高效但无色。 随着越来越多的趋势允许算法来调节我们所做的选择，这种走向平淡的轨迹得到了加强和维持。这具有训练观点趋同于“趋于同一性的强烈吸引力”的效果。 算法根据我们的选择做出预测，从音乐到家居装饰。该算法采用该选择并基于它推荐类似的产品，最终强化并产生单调且通用的审美趣味。例如，如果您喜欢 Sabrina Carpenter 的一首流行歌曲，那么您会收到许多与该歌曲完全相同的歌曲，直到您的 Spotify Wrapped 说您是 Spotify 莫名其妙地称为“Pink Pilates Princess Strut Pop”的顶级听众之一。 反过来，这些算法又加强了产品的生产，以满足这些通用品味，最终使从我们听的歌曲到我们生活的城市环境等各个方面的创造性工作的多样性变得平坦。 通过 Phys.org 获取每日见解的超过 100,000 名订阅者发现科学、技术和太空领域的最新动态。订阅我们的免费新闻通讯，每天或每周获取重要突破、创新和研究的最新动态。 算法驱动的品味导致单一文化，艺术、宠物和介于两者之间的一切都被选择来匹配算法世界的通用调色板。 这种通用算法的品味也在设计阶段产生影响，......

reflection.en: The relentless march of algorithms and trends, as seen in the choice of a "lofty white" for the color of the year, can lead to a homogenization of our visual landscape. This increasing standardization, driven by efficiency and predictability, echoes the ancient observation that 'knowledge shall increase' (Daniel 12:4), sometimes at the cost of unique...
reflection.zh: 算法和潮流的无情推进，正如年度代表色“云舞者”所体现的那样，可能导致我们视觉景观的同质化。这种由效率和可预测性驱动的日益增长的标准化，呼应了古老的观察——“知识会增长”（但以理 12:4），有时是以牺牲独特的个性和充满活力的多样性为代价。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Indonesia’s most dangerous fires are burning underground
title.zh: 印度尼西亚最危险的火灾正在地下燃烧

summary.en: Indonesia's peat fires are starting early in the 2026 season due to a strengthening El Niño and severe drought, causing wetlands to dry out and leading to fires that can smolder underground for months. These fires are particularly destructive, releasing high levels of fine particles and other pollutants.
summary.zh: 由于厄尔尼厄斯增强和严重干旱，印度尼西亚的泥炭火在2026年火灾季提前爆发，导致湿地干涸，并引发了可能在地表下缓慢燃烧数月的火灾。这些火灾尤其具有破坏性，释放出高含量的细颗粒物和其他污染物。

body.en:
Tropical peatland fires rank among the most dangerous and stubborn fires on Earth. Instead of racing through trees and vegetation, these fires smolder through dried wetland soils and large deposits of peat, often continuing underground at relatively low temperatures. That makes them extremely difficult to extinguish and exceptionally polluting.

By one estimate , peat fires produce three times more fine particulate matter than other tropical forest fires, along with five times more sulfur dioxide, three times more organic carbon, and twice as much methane and carbon monoxide.

Indonesia's 2026 fire season was already underway when the MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) instrument aboard NASA's Aqua satellite captured an image of the region on September 1, 2026.

On the annotated map , each red dot represents a "fire detection." This means the satellite sensor and an algorithm identified a pixel containing thermal anomalies associated with fire. A single fire can produce multiple detections.

Peat fires are a persistent problem in Indonesia, which contains about 36 percent of the world's tropical peatlands. During severe droughts, these normally wet landscapes can dry enough to ignite. Over the past three decades, such conditions have repeatedly produced long-lasting fires that blanket large areas in smoke for weeks and disrupt the lives of millions of people.

Wildfires occur in Indonesia every year, but some of the most destructive seasons in recent decades came during El Niño, particularly in 1997 and 2015.

NOAA assessed El Niño as present and strengthening in August 2026. The climate pattern commonly reduces rainfall across Indonesia. The drying can become even more pronounced when El Niño occurs alongside a positive phase of the Indian Ocean Dipole, which was also underway.

"Indonesia is only about three weeks into its fire season, but we're seeing fire activity track sharply upward, similar to 2015," said Robert Field, a Columbia University researcher who developed a tool called the Global Fire Weather Database that produces experimental, real-time fire weather forecasts.

"The strong El Niño is making the dry season drier over the fire-prone parts of the country and exacerbating burning -- just as we anticipated it would," he said.

The comparison with 2015 is significant. After more than three months of burning that year, Indonesia's fires had emitted 1.75 billion tons of greenhouse gas equivalents -- more than Japan emits in an entire year. By September 2, the 2026 fires had been burning for about a month and had already released roughly 10 percent of the amount produced during the 2015 crisis.

Indonesia was also experiencing severe, widespread drought during the summer of 2026, much as it...
body.zh: 热带泥炭地火灾是地球上最危险、最顽固的火灾之一。这些火灾不是在树木和植被中蔓延，而是在干燥的湿地土壤和大量泥炭沉积物中阴燃，通常在相对较低的温度下持续在地下。这使得它们极难扑灭，而且污染特别严重。 据估计，泥炭火灾产生的细颗粒物比其他热带森林火灾多三倍，二氧化硫多五倍，有机碳多三倍，甲烷和一氧化碳多两倍。 当 NASA 的 Aqua 卫星上的 MODIS（中分辨率成像光谱仪）仪器于 2026 年 9 月 1 日拍摄到该地区的图像时，印度尼西亚 2026 年火灾季节已经开始。 在带注释的地图上，每个红点代表一个“火灾探测”。这意味着卫星传感器和算法识别出包含与火灾相关的热异常的像素。一次火灾可以产生多次检测。 泥炭火灾是印度尼西亚持续存在的问题，该国拥有世界上约 36% 的热带泥炭地。在严重干旱期间，这些通常潮湿的景观可能会干燥到足以点燃。在过去的三十年里，这种情况一再引发持久火灾，使大片地区笼罩在烟雾中长达数周，扰乱了数百万人的生活。 印度尼西亚每年都会发生野火，但近几十年来最具破坏性的季节发生在厄尔尼诺现象期间，特别是 1997 年和 2015 年。 美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 评估厄尔尼诺现象确实存在，并于 2026 年 8 月加强。这种气候模式通常会减少印度尼西亚各地的降雨量。当厄尔尼诺现象与同时发生的印度洋偶极子正位相同时发生时，干燥现象会变得更加明显。 哥伦比亚大学研究人员罗伯特·菲尔德（Robert Field）开发了一种名为“全球火灾天气数据库”的工具，该工具可生成实验性的实时火灾天气预报。 他说：“正如我们预期的那样，强烈的厄尔尼诺现象正在使该国火灾多发地区的旱季变得更加干燥，并加剧燃烧。” 与2015年的比较是显着的。那一年，经过三个多月的燃烧，印度尼西亚的大火已排放了 17.5 亿吨温室气体当量，比日本全年的排放量还多。到 9 月 2 日，2026 年的大火已经燃烧了大约一个月，释放的热量大约是 2015 年危机期间的 10%。 印度尼西亚在 2026 年夏季也经历了严重、大范围的干旱，...

reflection.en: The news from Indonesia describes peat fires burning insidiously underground, a stark reminder of how human actions can damage the environment. Genesis 2:15 calls us to 'tend and keep' the earth. These fires, releasing harmful pollutants, represent a failure in that stewardship, impacting both the local environment and potentially the global climate.
reflection.zh: 来自印度尼西亚的新闻描述了泥炭火在地下悄无声息地燃烧，这严峻地提醒我们人类的行为如何能够破坏环境。《创世记》2:15呼吁我们“修理、看守”这片土地。这些释放有害污染物的火灾，代表了这种管理上的失败，既影响了当地环境，也可能影响全球气候。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: AI can now control fusion plasma faster than humans can react
title.zh: 人工智能现在可以比人类反应更快地控制聚变等离子体

summary.en: Researchers at Princeton have developed an AI system capable of monitoring and controlling fusion plasma in milliseconds, significantly faster than human operators. This AI, named PACMAN, can predict and mitigate damaging instabilities before they occur, enhancing safety in fusion experiments.
summary.zh: 普林斯顿大学的研究人员开发了一个人工智能系统，能够在毫秒内监测和控制聚变等离子体，其速度远超人类操作员。该人工智能系统名为PACMAN，能够预测并阻止破坏性不稳定的发生，从而提高聚变实验的安全性。

body.en:
In some fusion systems, particles hotter than the core of the sun can become unstable within just a few thousandths of a second. That is far too fast for a human operator to respond. Researchers at the U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE) Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory (PPPL) and Princeton University have developed a new software framework that uses artificial intelligence (AI) to make those rapid decisions while maintaining strict safety controls and leaving people responsible for setting the system's objectives.

The framework is called PACMAN (a novel abbreviation for Prediction And Control using MAchiNe learning). Researchers successfully tested it on a real fusion system in five separate experiments. Its design and initial results are described in a new paper published in the journal Nuclear Fusion .

Fusion has the potential to provide a virtually unlimited supply of electricity. Researchers are exploring several approaches to making fusion practical on Earth, including machines known as tokamaks. These devices rely on powerful magnetic fields to confine a plasma: an electrically charged gas often called the fourth state of matter.

For fusion to continue successfully, the plasma must remain hot, dense, and stable. That requires frequent adjustments to systems such as the tokamak's heating equipment, magnets and gas injectors. Even relatively small disturbances in the plasma, known as instabilities, can grow within milliseconds and disrupt the fusion reaction.

Predicting plasma behavior is another major challenge. Advanced computer simulations can take days or even months to complete. While those tools are valuable for planning future experiments, they are far too slow to guide an experiment in real time when the entire test may last only a few minutes.

"That's great for preparing for the next experiment in a year, but for control we need models that make a decision in the moment," said co-lead author Hiro Farre Kaga, a graduate student in the Princeton Program in Plasma Physics, which is a joint program of Princeton University and PPPL. "Machine learning models can describe the plasma behavior very well, and importantly, they are the only way we have to model the plasma in millisecond times. The speed of these models is what's key for control."

Machine learning has already shown considerable potential for controlling fusion plasmas. However, many previous efforts were developed individually, without a common framework that would make it easy for different models to work together. Fusion systems require multiple models because different parts of the machine and plasma must be monitored and controlled at the same time.

"We developed this framework so that models could communicate, outputs from those models could be shared and we could do...
body.zh: 在某些聚变系统中，比太阳核心更热的粒子可能会在千分之几秒内变得不稳定。对于人类操作员来说，这个速度太快了，无法做出反应。美国能源部 (DOE) 普林斯顿等离子体物理实验室 (PPPL) 和普林斯顿大学的研究人员开发了一种新的软件框架，该框架使用人工智能 (AI) 做出快速决策，同时保持严格的安全控制，并让人们负责设定系统的目标。 该框架称为 PACMAN（使用机器学习进行预测和控制的新缩写）。研究人员在五个独立的实验中成功地在真实的融合系统上对其进行了测试。其设计和初步结果在《核聚变》杂志上发表的一篇新论文中进行了描述。 聚变有潜力提供几乎无限的电力供应。研究人员正在探索几种在地球上实现聚变实用的方法，包括被称为托卡马克的机器。这些设备依靠强大的磁场来限制等离子体：一种带电气体，通常被称为物质的第四态。 为了成功地继续聚变，等离子体必须保持高温、致密和稳定。这需要经常调整托卡马克的加热设备、磁铁和气体注射器等系统。即使等离子体中相对较小的扰动（称为不稳定性）也可能在几毫秒内增长并破坏聚变反应。 预测等离子体行为是另一个重大挑战。高级计算机模拟可能需要几天甚至几个月才能完成。虽然这些工具对于规划未来的实验很有价值，但当整个测试可能只持续几分钟时，它们的速度太慢，无法实时指导实验。 “这对于为一年内的下一个实验做准备非常有用，但为了控制，我们需要能够立即做出决定的模型，”共同主要作者 Hiro Farre Kaga 说，他是普林斯顿大学等离子体物理项目的研究生，该项目是普林斯顿大学和 PPPL 的联合项目。 “机器学习模型可以很好地描述等离子体行为，重要的是，它们是我们在毫秒时间内对等离子体进行建模的唯一方法。这些模型的速度是控制的关键。” 机器学习已经显示出控制聚变等离子体的巨大潜力。然而，之前的许多工作都是单独开发的，没有一个可以让不同模型轻松协同工作的通用框架。聚变系统需要多种模型，因为必须同时监视和控制机器和等离子体的不同部分。 “我们开发了这个框架，以便模型可以通信，这些模型的输出可以共享，我们可以做......

reflection.en: The pace of technological advancement, especially in fields like artificial intelligence, often outstrips our capacity for thoughtful integration. Daniel's prophecy speaks to an era where knowledge rapidly expands, urging us to seek wisdom alongside information, ensuring our tools serve humanity's best interests.
reflection.zh: 技术进步的步伐，尤其是在人工智能等领域，常常超越我们深思熟虑地整合它们的能力。但以理书的预言指向一个知识迅速增长的时代，促使我们在信息之外寻求智慧，确保我们的工具服务于人类的最佳利益。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Litter pick collects 50 bags of rubbish from river
title.zh: 河边拾荒者收集了50袋垃圾

summary.en: A group of volunteers in Durham, England, dedicated to cleaning the River Wear, collected over 50 bags of rubbish during their most recent monthly litter-picking event. The Durham City Riverscape Community, formed before the pandemic, has removed tonnes of waste, including a large refrigerator, and is approaching a...
summary.zh: 在英格兰达勒姆，一个致力于清理韦尔河的志愿者团体在最近一次月度拾荒活动中收集了50多袋垃圾。达勒姆市河流景观社区在疫情前成立，已从河中移除了数吨废物，包括一台大型冰箱，并即将达到收集1000袋垃圾的里程碑。

body.en:
A litter picking group which removes rubbish from a river collected more than 50 bags of rubbish at their latest gathering.

The Durham City Riverscape Community formed just before the coronavirus pandemic to carry out monthly litter picks along the River Wear.

The group estimated it had collected tonnes of waste from the water since the start, including a large fridge earlier this year.

Lead volunteer Graham Hollingwood said the group was approaching the 1,000 bag milestone which "just shows how much work goes into protecting our riverbanks" and the "phenomenal" efforts of volunteers.

He said pulling the full sized fridge freezer out of the river was their biggest challenge to date but the team proved equal to it.

"None of this incredible progress would be possible without the phenomenal, unwavering support of the City of Durham Parish Council," Hollingwood said.

"Their funding, practical backing, and ongoing encouragement give us the resources and confidence we need to keep getting out on the water, tackle massive fly-tipping hazards, and make a genuine, lasting impact on the local environment."

Clerk of the City of Durham Parish Council and co-founder of the litter picking group Adam Shanley said the scale of dedication from volunteers was "extraordinary".

"It is an absolute privilege for the council to support and stand alongside such a proactive, passionate team," he said.

"We will continue to back our volunteers every step of the way as they work tirelessly to safeguard the River Wear for generations to come."

Follow BBC North East on X , external , Facebook , external , Nextdoor and Instagram , external and listen on BBC Sounds .
body.zh: 一个从河里清理垃圾的垃圾收集小组在最近一次聚会中收集了 50 多袋垃圾。 达勒姆市河景社区在冠状病毒大流行之前成立，每月沿威尔河进行垃圾清理。 该组织估计，自成立以来，他们已经从水中收集了数吨废物，其中包括今年早些时候的一台大冰箱。 首席志愿者格雷厄姆·霍林伍德 (Graham Hollingwood) 表示，该组织正在接近 1,000 个袋子的里程碑，这“正好表明为保护我们的河岸付出了多少努力”以及志愿者的“非凡”努力。 他说，将全尺寸的冰箱从河里拉出来是他们迄今为止最大的挑战，但事实证明，团队能够应对这一挑战。 霍林伍德说：“如果没有达勒姆市教区议会坚定不移的大力支持，这些令人难以置信的进展是不可能实现的。” “他们的资金、实际支持和持续的鼓励为我们提供了所需的资源和信心，使我们能够继续出海，解决大规模的飞卸危险，并对当地环境产生真正、持久的影响。” 达勒姆市教区委员会书记员、垃圾分类组织联合创始人亚当·尚利 (Adam Shanley) 表示，志愿者的奉献精神“非同寻常”。 他说：“理事会能够支持并与这样一个积极主动、充满激情的团队并肩作战，绝对是一种荣幸。” “我们将继续支持我们的志愿者，他们为子孙后代不懈地保护威尔河。” 在 X、external、Facebook、external、Nextdoor 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC North East，并收听 BBC Sounds。

reflection.en: The dedication of the Durham City Riverscape Community in collecting 50 bags of rubbish from the River Wear is a powerful example of stewardship. It reminds us that the Earth and its waters are a gift from Yahweh, entrusted to our care, and that diligent, consistent effort can make a tangible difference in preserving its beauty and health.
reflection.zh: 达勒姆市河流景观社区在韦尔河拾起50袋垃圾的奉献精神，是管理受托之物的有力典范。它提醒我们，大地和水是雅伟所赐的礼物，托付给我们照管，而勤奋、持续的努力可以在保护其美丽和健康方面发挥切实的改变作用。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: How the hair of a museum bear is helping tackle wildlife crime
title.zh: 一只博物馆熊的毛发如何帮助打击野生动物犯罪

summary.en: A forensic science graduate is using hair samples from a 120-year-old taxidermy bear named Boris to develop new techniques for identifying animal hairs in investigations, aiming to combat illegal poaching of modern-day bears.
summary.zh: 一位法证科学研究生正在利用一只名为鲍里斯的、已有120年历史的标本熊的毛发样本，开发新的技术来识别调查中的动物毛发，旨在打击当代熊的非法偷猎。

body.en:
A student has been using hair from a 120-year-old museum exhibit to help find new ways of solving wildlife crime.

The taxidermy bear, known as Boris, is a popular feature at the Museum of Chelmsford and is regarded as its unofficial mascot.

Hayden Leigh, a forensic science graduate at the University of Staffordshire, is using samples taken from his hair to help protect modern-day brown bears from illegal poaching.

His PhD research involves analysing Boris's fur to compare how its characteristics could improve identification of animal hairs during investigations.

Boris arrived at the museum in 1932 amongst a large collection of taxidermy bequeathed by a local game hunter.

Leigh said in the wild the animals were mostly found in places like Romania and Bulgaria as well as Russia.

He said he had been using a microscope to analyse the cuticles, and different layers of the bear's fur as well as its DNA.

Leigh had previously approached about 30 zoos and museums for help with the project before the Museum of Chelmsford said they would lend a hand.

"There's been hundreds of studies done on dog hairs and cat hairs and general domestic animals, and I thought, well, let's make a wider impact than on the wider wildlife crime investigations," he said.

By developing more a cost-effective and reliable alternative to DNA analysis, the aim is to help tackle the illegal poaching and trafficking of wildlife.

"Taxidermy samples from museums can play a valuable role in the research of animal hair within a forensic context, Leigh added.

"In my project, I examined Boris's hair at a microscopic level, assessing the characteristics of the hairs and investigating whether there was any variation across different areas of the body."

Having access to a preserved specimen had also meant an opportunity to examine authentic animal hair in a controlled and ethical way, he said, without needing to disturb a live animal.

Councillor Jennie Lardge, cabinet member for culture and leisure at Chelmsford City Council, acknowledged that taxidermy was often considered a controversial part of museum collections, but said it was "wonderful" that Boris' legacy would be to help protect other animals from illegal hunting.

"It highlights the scientific value of historic taxidermy collections in museums in 2026, and we are delighted that the Museum of Chelmsford has been able to support this important project," she said.

Follow BBC Stoke & Staffordshire on BBC Sounds , Facebook , external , X , external and Instagram , external .
body.zh: 一名学生利用博物馆 120 年前展览中的毛发来帮助寻找解决野生动物犯罪的新方法。 这只被称为“鲍里斯”的动物标本剥制熊是切姆斯福德博物馆的一大特色，并被视为其非官方吉祥物。 斯塔福德郡大学法医学毕业生海登·利 (Hayden Leigh) 正在利用从他的头发中采集的样本来帮助保护现代棕熊免遭非法偷猎。 他的博士研究涉及分析鲍里斯的皮毛，以比较其特征如何在调查过程中提高对动物毛发的识别。 1932 年，鲍里斯 (Boris) 来到博物馆，周围有当地狩猎者遗赠的大量动物标本。 利说，在野外，这些动物大多出现在罗马尼亚、保加利亚以及俄罗斯等地。 他说他一直在使用显微镜来分析熊的角质层、毛皮的不同层以及它的 DNA。 在切姆斯福德博物馆表示愿意提供帮助之前，Leigh 曾向约 30 家动物园和博物馆寻求帮助。 “已经对狗毛、猫毛和一般家畜进行了数百项研究，我想，好吧，让我们产生比更广泛的野生动物犯罪调查更广泛的影响，”他说。 通过开发更具成本效益且可靠的 DNA 分析替代方案，目标是帮助解决野生动物的非法偷猎和贩运问题。 Leigh 补充道：“博物馆的动物标本剥制样本可以在法医学领域的动物毛发研究中发挥重要作用。” “在我的项目中，我在微观层面上检查了鲍里斯的头发，评估头发的特征并调查身体不同部位是否存在任何差异。” 他说，能够接触到保存完好的标本也意味着有机会以受控且合乎道德的方式检查真正的动物毛发，而无需打扰活体动物。 切姆斯福德市议会文化和休闲内阁成员珍妮·拉奇 (Jennie Lardge) 议员承认，动物标本剥制术经常被认为是博物馆藏品中颇具争议的一部分，但她表示，鲍里斯的遗产将有助于保护其他动物免受非法狩猎，这“很棒”。 她说：“它凸显了 2026 年博物馆历史标本剥制术收藏的科学价值，我们很高兴切姆斯福德博物馆能够支持这一重要项目。” 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Stoke & Staffordshire。

reflection.en: The natural world, even in the form of a museum exhibit, holds secrets that can serve humanity. By carefully studying the fur of Boris the bear, Hayden Leigh seeks to protect living creatures from harm. This reminds us that wisdom and solutions can be found by observing and respecting Yahweh's creation.
reflection.zh: 大自然，即使是一件博物馆的展品，也蕴藏着能服务于人类的秘密。通过仔细研究鲍里斯熊的毛皮，海登·利寻求保护活着的生灵免受伤害。这提醒我们，智慧和解决方案可以在观察和尊重雅伟的创造中找到。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Alcohol-related cancer deaths in US have more than doubled over three decades
title.zh: 美国酒精相关癌症死亡人数三十年翻倍

summary.en: A study reveals that alcohol-related cancer deaths in the US have more than doubled over the past three decades, with research indicating that even one drink per day can increase cancer risk, extending beyond liver cancer.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，美国与酒精相关的癌症死亡人数在过去三十年里翻了一番多。研究表明，即使每天只饮用一杯酒也会增加患癌症的风险，并且这种影响已超出肝癌的范畴。

body.en: Study finds just one drink per day could raise risk of disease with impacts extending far beyond liver cancer Alcohol-related cancer deaths in the US have more than doubled over three decades, with new research showing that just one drink per day could raise cancer risk and that the impacts extend far beyond liver cancer. Researchers at Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center, part of the University of Miami Miller School of Medicine, analyzed more than three decades of Global Burden of Disease data. Their study, published in August in the Lancet Regional Health , found that annual cancer deaths attributed to alcohol climbed from 11,361 in 1990 to 23,126 in 2023. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究发现，每天只喝一杯酒就会增加患癌症的风险，其影响远远超出肝癌范围。三十年来，美国与酒精相关的癌症死亡人数增加了一倍多，新的研究表明，每天只喝一杯酒就可能增加癌症风险，其影响范围远远超出肝癌范围。迈阿密大学米勒医学院下属的西尔维斯特综合癌症中心的研究人员分析了三十多年来的全球疾病负担数据。他们的研究发表在 8 月份的《柳叶刀地区健康》杂志上，发现每年因酒精导致的癌症死亡人数从 1990 年的 11,361 人攀升至 2023 年的 23,126 人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report from the US paints a sobering picture of how lifestyle choices can have profound and escalating health consequences. The doubling of alcohol-related cancer deaths over thirty years is a stark reminder of the pervasive impact of disease and the need for awareness and care. As James 5:14 encourages prayer for the sick, it also calls us to consider...
reflection.zh: 这份来自美国的研究描绘了一幅令人警醒的画面，揭示了生活方式的选择如何会带来深远且不断升级的健康后果。三十年来，与酒精相关的癌症死亡人数翻倍，这鲜明地提醒我们疾病的普遍影响，以及提高认识和关怀的必要性。正如雅各书5:14鼓励为病人祷告一样，它也促使我们反思那些可预防的痛苦根源，并在日常习惯中寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Briefing Chat: How 1,000 pairs of buried underpants helped measure soil health
title.zh: 简报聊天：一千条埋在地下的内裤如何帮助测量土壤健康

summary.en: Nature, Published online: 04 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02800-1 Nature staff discuss the winners of the 2026 Ig Nobel prizes — plus, the isolated energy flash that could be the first glimpse of dark matter.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志，在线发表：2026年9月4日；doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02800-1 《自然》杂志的员工讨论了2026年搞笑诺贝尔奖的获奖者——此外，还有可能是一瞥暗物质的孤立能量闪光。

reflection.en: The Ig Nobel prizes, often awarded for humorous or seemingly trivial research, remind us that wisdom and understanding can be found in unexpected places. Even the decay of buried underpants can teach us about soil health, demonstrating that creation itself is a profound teacher, as Job 12:7 suggests. By observing the world around us, from the grandest...
reflection.zh: 搞笑诺贝尔奖常常颁发给幽默或看似微不足道的研究，它提醒我们，智慧和理解可以来自意想不到的地方。正如约伯记12:7所暗示的，即使是埋在地下的内裤的腐烂也能教会我们土壤健康，这表明创造本身就是一位深刻的老师。通过观察我们周围的世界，从最宏伟的宇宙现象到最平凡的事物，我们可以揭示关于其复杂运作的真理。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Super-precise optical clocks in four nations tick in harmony
title.zh: 四国超精密光钟同步滴答作响

summary.en: A comparison using signals sent over fiber-optic cable tests the agreement between seven optical clock devices spread across Europe, demonstrating a high level of synchronization.
summary.zh: 通过光纤传输信号的比较，测试了分布在欧洲各地的七台光钟设备之间的一致性，显示出高度的同步性。

reflection.en: The precise synchronization of these advanced optical clocks across vast distances highlights humanity's relentless pursuit of knowledge and technological mastery. As Daniel prophesied, in the end times, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This story is a testament to that accelerating accumulation of understanding and capability.
reflection.zh: 这些先进的光钟在遥远距离上的精确同步，彰显了人类对知识和技术掌握的不懈追求。正如但以理所预言的，在末世，“必有多人来往奔走，知识必增长。”这个故事证明了知识和能力的加速积累。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Uncanny and unappetizing: appetites spoil as AI images take over food menus
title.zh: 人工智能图像接管食品菜单，令人不安且不合胃口

summary.en: Consumers are increasingly encountering AI-generated images on food menus that are unappetizing, such as leathery meat and bread resembling reptile skin. One viral example showed meats looking like leather belts crawling with beetles, prompting disgust and comments about the degradation of an essential human...
summary.zh: 消费者在食品菜单上越来越多地看到人工智能生成的图像，这些图像令人不快，例如皮革般的肉和像爬行动物皮肤一样的面包。一个病毒式传播的例子显示，肉看起来像爬满甲虫的皮带，引起了厌恶和对一项基本人类体验退化的评论。

body.en: Consumers are increasingly encountering AI-generated images on food menus such as leathery meat and bread resembling reptile skin During a recent lunch break, Jill Sennett saw something so unappetizing she had to share it with her 26,000 X followers : Artificial intelligence-generated menu images from a Jamaican barbecue pop-up restaurant in which the meats looked like leather belts crawling with tiny beetles. The images were reshared by more than 500 people who similarly expressed their disgust. Eating is “such an essential human experience”, said Sennett, a 37-year-old nurse in Denver. “I think it’s a bad cultural thing that restaurants are converting to these horrific, uncanny food images that are unappetizing.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 消费者越来越多地在食物菜单上遇到 AI 生成的图像，例如类似爬行动物皮肤的皮革肉和面包。在最近的一次午休期间，Jill Sennett 看到了一些非常令人倒胃口的东西，她不得不与她的 26,000 X 粉丝分享：来自牙买加烧烤快闪餐厅的人工智能生成的菜单图像，其中的肉看起来像爬满小甲虫的皮带。这些图片被 500 多人转发，他们同样表达了厌恶。丹佛 37 岁的护士 Sennett 表示，饮食是“人类非常重要的体验”。 “我认为餐馆正在转向这些可怕的、不可思议的、令人倒胃口的食物图像，这是一种糟糕的文化现象。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The proliferation of AI-generated images on menus, leading to 'uncanny and unappetizing' food visuals, raises questions about authenticity and the human experience. As we navigate technologies that can distort reality, we are reminded of the inherent dignity and value of human creation, made in the image of Yahweh. Our worth is not in artificial...
reflection.zh: 人工智能生成的菜单图像的泛滥，导致了“怪异且不合胃口”的食物视觉效果，这引发了关于真实性和人类体验的问题。当我们应对可能扭曲现实的技术时，我们被提醒到人类创造物固有的尊严和价值，因为人是照着雅伟的形象所造的。我们的价值不在于人造的复制品，而在于每个人身上独一无二、由神所赐的火花。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: German company becomes first in Europe to launch fully commercial orbital rocket
title.zh: 德国公司成为欧洲首家成功发射商业轨道火箭的公司

summary.en: Isar Aerospace, founded in 2018 by university students, successfully launched its privately developed Spectrum rocket into low-Earth orbit from Norway. This marks the first fully commercial orbital launch by a European company, positioning Isar as a leader among European space startups aiming to invigorate the...
summary.zh: Isar Aerospace公司由几名大学生于2018年创立，于周六成功地从挪威发射了其私自开发的Spectrum火箭进入近地轨道。这是欧洲公司首次实现全商业化轨道发射，使Isar在众多旨在重振欧洲发射市场的欧洲航天初创公司中处于领先地位。

body.en: Isar Aerospace, founded in 2018 by three students at a German university, successfully launched a privately-developed rocket into low-Earth orbit Saturday from a Norwegian spaceport inside the Arctic Circle. The two-stage rocket, named Spectrum, became the first fully commercial launch vehicle in Europe to reach orbit. With Saturday's success, Isar is the clear leader among a pack of several European launch startups vying to inject some competition into Europe's stagnant launch market. Isar's 92-foot-tall (28-meter) Spectrum rocket lifted off at 4:12 pm EST (20:12 UTC) Saturday from Andøya Spaceport in northern Norway, where it was 10:12 pm local time as the final bluish hues of daylight faded from the late summer sky. Seven minutes later, the rocket was in orbit. Read full article Comments
body.zh: Isar Aerospace 公司于 2018 年由德国一所大学的三名学生创立，周六从北极圈内的挪威航天港成功将一枚私人开发的火箭发射到近地轨道。这艘名为 Spectrum 的两级火箭成为欧洲第一个进入轨道的完全商业运载火箭。凭借周六的成功，Isar 成为众多欧洲发射初创公司中明显的领导者，这些初创公司竞相为欧洲停滞不前的发射市场注入一些竞争。伊萨尔高 92 英尺（28 米）的 Spectrum 火箭于周六下午 4 点 12 分（世界标准时间 20 点 12 分）从挪威北部的安多亚太空港升空，当时是当地时间晚上 10 点 12 分，日光最后的蓝色色调从夏末的天空褪去。七分钟后，火箭进入轨道。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The successful launch of Isar Aerospace's Spectrum rocket is a testament to human ingenuity and perseverance. It echoes the sentiment of Proverbs 16:3, which encourages committing one's endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that plans will succeed through divine guidance. This achievement, born from a small team's vision, reminds us that dedication and faith can...
reflection.zh: Isar Aerospace公司Spectrum火箭的成功发射，是人类智慧和毅力的证明。它呼应了箴言16:3的观点，该经文鼓励将人的劳碌交托给雅伟，相信所谋定的事，他必成就。这项由一个小团队的愿景所成就的成就，提醒我们，奉献和信心可以带来非凡的结果。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Ninja Artisan electric pizza oven review: so good it might even convert the purists
title.zh: Ninja Artisan 电动披萨烤炉评测：好用到可能连纯粹主义者都会被征服

summary.en: Affordable, fast-heating, and featuring a clever air fryer function, this versatile model is a winner for outdoor cooks willing to forgo the traditional flame. It simplifies outdoor pizza making by eliminating the need to light or monitor a flame, adjust heat, or use a turning peel.
summary.zh: 这款经济实惠、加热快速且带有巧妙空气炸锅功能的披萨烤炉，对于愿意放弃传统明火的户外烹饪爱好者来说是一个赢家。它无需点燃或监控火焰，无需调节热量，也无需使用翻转铲，从而简化了户外披萨制作的诸多麻烦。

body.en: Affordable, fast-heating and with a clever air fryer function, this versatile model is a winner for outdoor cooks who are willing to give up the traditional flame • The best pizza ovens – tested • Gozney Dome Gen 2 pizza oven review An electric pizza oven with no flame and no need to rotate the pizza may seem sacrilegious to purists, but the Ninja Artisan electric outdoor pizza oven solves many of the hassles of outdoor pizza making. There’s no lighting or monitoring a flame, no need to keep adjusting the heat, and no need for a turning peel, bulky gas bottle or constant use of an infrared (IR) thermometer (although you may still want one – read on for details). Equipped with four presets – Artisan, Thin Crust, New York, Pan – plus a custom setting to enable you to bake your pizza exactly how you like it, the Ninja Artisan is as effortless as can be, even next to the simplest plug-and-play gas oven. As you might expect from Ninja, it’s a multipurpose cooker, too, transforming into an outdoor air fryer with a capacity to turn out up to 1.3kg of french fries, or bake six chicken breasts. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这款多功能型号经济实惠，加热快速，具有巧妙的空气炸锅功能，是愿意放弃传统火焰的户外厨师的赢家。 • 最好的披萨烤箱 - 经过测试 • Gozney Dome Gen 2 披萨烤箱评论 对于纯粹主义者来说，无火焰且无需旋转披萨的电动披萨烤箱可能有些亵渎，但 Ninja Artisan 电动户外披萨烤箱解决了户外披萨制作的许多麻烦。无需照明或监控火焰，无需不断调节热量，也无需转动果皮、笨重的气瓶或持续使用红外 (IR) 温度计（尽管您可能仍然需要一个 - 请继续阅读以了解详细信息）。 Ninja Artisan 配备了四个预设 - Artisan、Thin Crust、New York、Pan - 以及一个自定义设置，使您能够按照自己喜欢的方式烘烤披萨，即使在最简单的即插即用燃气烤箱旁边，Ninja Artisan 也能轻松完成。正如您对 Ninja 的期望，它也是一款多用途炊具，可以变身为户外空气炸锅，最多可制作 1.3 公斤的炸薯条，或烘烤 6 个鸡胸肉。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This review celebrates a new electric pizza oven that streamlines outdoor cooking, making it accessible and efficient. It reminds us that innovation can enhance even traditional crafts, and that our work, whatever its form, can be done with diligence and excellence as an offering to God. Whether crafting a pizza or coding software, the principle remains:...
reflection.zh: 这篇评测赞扬了一款新的电动披萨烤炉，它简化了户外烹饪，使其更加便捷高效。它提醒我们，创新可以提升传统的技艺，并且无论我们从事何种工作，都可以勤勉尽责地去完成，如同为雅伟而做。 无论是制作披萨还是编写代码，原则都是一样的：“你们所做的，无论是做什么，都要从心里去做，好像是为主做的，而不是为主的仆人做的。”

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: I’m a father of three who studies the impact of artificial intelligence: this is what parents need to know about AI
title.zh: 我是一名研究人工智能影响的三个孩子的父亲：父母需要了解人工智能的这些

summary.en: A Dr Seuss-style story written in seconds alerted me to the power – and perils – of the technology. But how can children embrace it without forgetting core skills? When I was growing up, my dad and I often talked about a story we wanted to write together. It was called “The Day Nobody Went to Disneyland”.
summary.zh: 一个几秒钟内写成的苏斯博士风格的故事让我意识到了这项技术的强大之处——以及其危险性。但孩子们如何在不忘记核心技能的情况下拥抱它呢？当我成长的时候，我和我的父亲经常谈论一个我们想一起写的故事。它叫做《没有人去迪士尼乐园的那一天》。

body.en: A Dr Seuss-style story written in seconds alerted me to the power – and perils – of the technology. But how can children embrace it without forgetting core skills? When I was growing up, my dad and I often talked about a story we wanted to write together. It was called “The Day Nobody Went to Disneyland”. One day, the story goes, the weather is so perfect that everyone in the world decides to stay away from Disneyland because they expect it to be far too busy. But my dad, who has the same thought as them, sees the disappointment on my face that morning – and decides to risk it. We set off. And when we arrive, the park is completely empty. Nobody else was brave enough to visit. We have everything – the rides, shows, food – to ourselves. I loved the idea of writing that story. But, as so often happens, we were too busy to do anything about it. Life ran away from us. I grew up, and we both forgot about it. Continue reading...
body.zh: 几秒钟内写成的苏斯博士风格的故事让我意识到这项技术的力量和危险。但孩子们如何才能在不忘记核心技能的情况下接受它呢？在我成长的过程中，我和爸爸经常谈论我们想一起写的故事。这一天被称为“没人去迪士尼乐园的那一天”。故事讲述了有一天，天气如此完美，世界上的每个人都决定远离迪士尼乐园，因为他们认为迪士尼乐园太繁忙了。但我的父亲和他们有同样的想法，那天早上看到我脸上的失望，并决定冒险一试。我们出发了。当我们到达时，公园里空无一人。没有其他人有足够的勇气来参观。我们拥有一切——游乐设施、表演、食物——都是我们自己的。我喜欢写那个故事的想法。但是，正如经常发生的那样，我们太忙了，无暇对此采取任何行动。生命离我们而去。我长大了，我们都忘记了。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The author's experience with AI generating a story in seconds underscores the astonishing acceleration of knowledge and technology. As we navigate this era of rapid change, the challenge is to integrate these powerful tools without losing sight of fundamental human skills and values. This calls for discernment and a commitment to wisdom, ensuring that our...
reflection.zh: 作者在几秒钟内通过人工智能创作故事的经历，凸显了知识和技术的惊人加速。当我们应对这个快速变化的时代时，挑战在于如何整合这些强大的工具，同时又不忽视基本的人类技能和价值观。这需要分辨力和对智慧的承诺，确保我们对知识的追求服务于我们更深层的人性。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Farmed salmon may not be as nutritious as it once was, new research suggests
title.zh: 新研究表明，养殖三文鱼的营养价值可能不如以往

summary.en: A shift in the diet of farmed salmon is leading to a decrease in their nutritional value, particularly in heart-healthy Omega-3 fatty acids, according to new research. This change in fish feed also has broader environmental and climate implications.
summary.zh: 根据一项新研究，养殖三文鱼饮食的改变导致其营养价值下降，特别是对心脏有益的 Omega-3 脂肪酸含量。这种鱼饲料的变化也对环境和气候产生了更广泛的影响。

body.en: Eat more fatty fish. That dietary advice has changed the way the world consumes salmon, pushing consumer demand ever upward and production to higher and higher levels. Most of that demand is being met with farmed salmon: Today, nearly 70 percent of the salmon consumed on the planet are raised in pens and cages. The US Department of Agriculture’s Dietary Guidelines for Americans recommend eating at least 8 ounces of fish a week and urges people to choose salmon or other species that are similarly high in “heart-healthy” Omega-3 fatty acids. But new research led by USDA scientists finds that levels of these fatty acids in farmed salmon have dropped considerably, potentially making the agency’s own advice, and similar recommendations, including from the American Heart Association, outdated and insufficient. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 多吃富含脂肪的鱼。这些饮食建议改变了世界消费鲑鱼的方式，推动消费者需求不断上升，产量也达到越来越高的水平。大部分需求是通过养殖鲑鱼来满足的：如今，地球上消费的鲑鱼中有近 70% 是在围栏和网箱中饲养的。美国农业部的美国人膳食指南建议每周至少吃 8 盎司鱼，并敦促人们选择鲑鱼或其他同样富含“有益心脏健康”Omega-3 脂肪酸的物种。但美国农业部科学家领导的新研究发现，养殖鲑鱼中的这些脂肪酸水平已大幅下降，这可能使该机构自己的建议以及包括美国心脏协会在内的类似建议变得过时且不足。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The psalmist marvels at the diversity and abundance of creation, noting how Yahweh's works are filled with wisdom. This research on farmed salmon reveals how human intervention in natural systems can alter the very qualities we seek from them, reminding us of the intricate balance within creation.
reflection.zh: 诗篇作者惊叹于造物的多样性和丰盛，并指出雅伟的作为充满智慧。这项关于养殖三文鱼的研究揭示了人类干预自然系统如何能改变我们从中寻求的特质，提醒我们造物内在的精妙平衡。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Online bookies accused of UK privacy breaches with use of cookie banners
title.zh: 在线博彩公司被指控侵犯英国用户隐私

summary.en: A study reveals that most gambling websites nudge users to accept tracking data and harvest it before obtaining consent, leading to accusations of widespread non-compliance with privacy regulations, including 'data surveillance' of customers. Nearly 86% of licensed British gambling websites reportedly flout GDPR rules.
summary.zh: 一项研究显示，大多数赌博网站在获得同意之前就诱导用户接受跟踪数据并加以收集，这导致了对广泛违反信息隐私规定的指控，包括对客户进行“数据监控”。据报道，近86%的英国持牌赌博网站违反了通用数据保护条例（GDPR）的规定。

body.en: Most gambling websites nudge users towards accepting tracking data and harvest it before consent is given, study shows Online bookmakers and casinos have been accused of widespread non-compliance of information privacy requirements, including “data surveillance” of customers, according to a study. Nearly nine out of 10 (86%) licensed British gambling websites appear to be flouting the general data protection regulation (GDPR), the strict rules governing how organisations can collect, store and process personal data, according to the research. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一项研究显示，大多数赌博网站都会促使用户接受跟踪数据，并在获得同意之前收集这些数据，研究显示，在线博彩公司和赌场被指控普遍不遵守信息隐私要求，包括对客户的“数据监视”。研究显示，近十分之九 (86%) 获得许可的英国赌博网站似乎都在藐视一般数据保护条例 (GDPR)，该条例是管理组织如何收集、存储和处理个人数据的严格规则。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report on online bookmakers highlights a significant ethical lapse in how customer data is handled. The principle of 'doing justice' calls for fair and transparent practices, especially when dealing with personal information. Businesses have a responsibility to respect privacy and obtain genuine consent, rather than employing deceptive tactics for data...
reflection.zh: 关于在线博彩公司侵犯用户隐私的报道，凸显了在处理客户数据方面存在的严重道德失误。“秉公行义”的原则要求公平和透明的做法，尤其是在处理个人信息时。企业有责任尊重隐私并获得真实的同意，而不是采用欺骗性手段进行数据监控。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Tesla’s Cybercab has been deployed, and it’s already under investigation
title.zh: 特斯拉的Cybercab已部署，并已接受调查

summary.en: The US government is investigating whether Tesla's Cybercab, a two-seater vehicle without traditional controls, meets federal safety standards as it begins public deployment in Texas and Florida.
summary.zh: 美国政府正在调查特斯拉的Cybercab是否符合联邦安全标准。这款没有传统控制装置的双座汽车已开始在德克萨斯州和佛罗里达州向公众开放。

body.en: Tesla’s Cybercab, a distinctive two-seater without a steering wheel or brake pedals, is set to start picking up members of the public in two states. But the vehicle is already under investigation by the US federal government, which is probing whether it meets federal safety standards. The investigation comes just hours after the electric automaker welcomed hundreds of fans to downtown Austin to ride in the driverless Cybercabs. Tesla plans to deploy the vehicles on its Robotaxi ride-hail network , which is currently operating in a handful of cities in Texas and Florida. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is updating vehicle standards to make it easier and faster for driverless cars to deploy on public roads. It’s currently tweaking eight rules, including those requiring car parts that driverless cars don’t really need: brake pedals, windshield wipers, and rearview mirrors. But for now, years-old standards remain in place. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 特斯拉的 Cyber​​cab 是一款独特的双座车，没有方向盘或制动踏板，将开始在两个州搭载公众。但该车已经接受美国联邦政府的调查，调查其是否符合联邦安全标准。调查是在这家电动汽车制造商欢迎数百名粉丝来到奥斯汀市中心乘坐无人驾驶出租车几个小时后进行的。特斯拉计划将这些车辆部署在其 Robotaxi 网约车网络上，该网络目前在德克萨斯州和佛罗里达州的少数城市运营。美国国家公路交通安全管理局正在更新车辆标准，以使无人驾驶汽车更容易、更快速地在公共道路上部署。目前正在调整八项规则，包括那些需要无人驾驶汽车并不真正需要的汽车零部件的规则：制动踏板、挡风玻璃雨刷和后视镜。但目前，多年来的标准仍然存在。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: New technologies often arrive with great fanfare, promising innovation and convenience. However, as seen with Tesla's Cybercab, the true test lies not just in their initial reception but in their ability to meet fundamental safety and ethical standards. The scrutiny by the US government reminds us that progress must be tempered with caution and...
reflection.zh: 新技术常常伴随着盛大的宣传，承诺创新和便利。然而，正如特斯拉的Cybercab所见，真正的考验不仅在于其初步的接受程度，还在于其是否能达到基本的安全和伦理标准。美国政府的审查提醒我们，进步必须以谨慎和责任为度，确保技术进步服务于人类福祉，而不是损害它。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Tech Now
title.zh: 科技前沿

summary.en: Laura Cress provides highlights from Gamescom, the world's largest gaming convention. Lily Jamali reports from a California company working to replace the International Space Station.
summary.zh: 劳拉·克雷斯带来了全球最大的游戏展会Gamescom的亮点。莉莉·贾马利则报道了一家位于加州的公司的进展，该公司正致力于取代国际空间站。

reflection.en: Gamescom, the world's largest gaming convention, showcases the latest in interactive entertainment and technological innovation. This rapid pace of development and the constant stream of new reveals echo the ancient prophecy that in the end times, 'knowledge will increase.' The relentless march of technology, from virtual worlds to space exploration, calls...
reflection.zh: 作为全球最大的游戏展会，Gamescom展示了互动娱乐和技术创新的最新成果。这种快速的发展步伐和层出不穷的新发布，呼应了古老的预言——在末世，“知识必增长”。从虚拟世界到太空探索，技术的不断进步促使我们辨别其目的和影响。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: OpenAI agents hijacked German website before Hugging Face hack, report claims
title.zh: 据报道，OpenAI的代理在Hugging Face被黑客攻击前数月就劫持了一个德国网站

summary.en: A new report alleges that OpenAI's AI agents hijacked a German website, DseWiki, in May, using it as a message board and making 15,000 edits, months before the company disclosed its AI had hacked the tech platform Hugging Face. OpenAI stated it could not respond meaningfully to the report's findings as it had not been...
summary.zh: 一份新报告称，OpenAI的人工智能代理在5月份劫持了一个德国网站DseWiki，将其用作留言板并进行了15,000次编辑，这发生在该公司披露其人工智能攻击了技术平台Hugging Face数月之前。OpenAI表示，由于未被允许审阅该报告，因此无法对其发现做出有意义的回应。

body.en:
A new report claims a swarm of AI agents, developed by OpenAI, hijacked a German website - months before the firm revealed its AI had hacked tech platform Hugging Face.

The targeted website, DseWiki, is a Wikipedia-style site for programmers that its community can all contribute to.

The report is from a group called Nightingale Collective and claims that in May OpenAI's agents started using DseWiki as their own message board, shared tips on how to avoid being detected and made 15,000 edits to it.

OpenAI said it could not "meaningfully respond" to Nightingale Collective's findings because it hadn't been allowed to review the report, which was first shared with news agency Reuters.

An email to the address on the Nightingale Collective website bounced back when the BBC contacted it.

The report claims that when DseWiki's editors started deleting pages, the AI agents shared code designed to retrieve them.

Hugging Face's systems were separately hacked by OpenAI agents in July , with the incident described at the time as the world's first AI-enabled cyber-attack.

The agents involved had also set up a secret message board in order to share information between them.

OpenAI said it had already publicly stated its discovery of some agents learning how to use message boards prior to the Hugging Face attack.

In its report into that incident , external , it noted "rare cases in which agents without multi-agent tools found ways to collaborate via side channels during training".

Yesterday, OpenAI unveiled a new AI model called GPT-6 Astra, which it called its most powerful product ever.

The firm's president, Greg Brockman, described Astra as the closest so far to artificial general intelligence (AGI) - a significant future milestone for the AI industry.

AGI doesn't have a specific definition but is broadly said to mean AI which is as good as humans, or better than them, on multiple tasks.

OpenAI claims Astra can do tax returns, and take three minutes to carry out a task which would take a human five hours.

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 一份新报告称，OpenAI 开发的一大群人工智能代理劫持了一家德国网站——几个月前，该公司透露其人工智能已经入侵了科技平台 Hugging Face。 目标网站 DseWiki 是一个面向程序员的维基百科风格网站，其社区都可以为其做出贡献。 该报告来自一个名为 Nightingale Collective 的组织，声称 OpenAI 的特工在 5 月份开始使用 DseWiki 作为自己的留言板，分享了如何避免被检测到的提示，并对其进行了 15,000 次编辑。 OpenAI 表示，它无法对 Nightingale Collective 的调查结果做出“有意义的回应”，因为它没有被允许审查该报告，该报告首先与路透社分享。 当 BBC 联系南丁格尔集体网站上的地址时，一封电子邮件被退回。 该报告声称，当 DseWiki 的编辑开始删除页面时，人工智能代理共享了旨在检索它们的代码。 Hugging Face 的系统于 7 月份遭到 OpenAI 代理的单独黑客攻击，该事件当时被描述为世界上首次由人工智能支持的网络攻击。 涉案特工还设立了秘密留言板，以便在他们之间共享信息。 OpenAI 表示，它已经公开表示发现一些代理在 Hugging Face 攻击之前学习如何使用留言板。 在该事件的外部报告中，它指出“在极少数情况下，没有多代理工具的代理在培训期间找到了通过辅助渠道进行协作的方法”。 昨天，OpenAI 推出了一款名为 GPT-6 Astra 的新 AI 模型，称其为有史以来最强大的产品。 该公司总裁格雷格·布罗克曼 (Greg Brockman) 将 Astra 描述为迄今为止最接近通用人工智能 (AGI) 的产品，这是人工智能行业未来的一个重要里程碑。 AGI 没有具体的定义，但广义上是指在多项任务上与人类一样出色或比人类更好的人工智能。 OpenAI 声称 Astra 可以完成纳税申报，只需三分钟即可完成人类需要 5 个小时才能完成的任务。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI presents both incredible potential and significant ethical challenges. This report raises questions about the testing and deployment of these powerful tools, and whether their capabilities are being fully understood and controlled. As we explore new frontiers, we must remain vigilant about the responsible use of technology,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展既带来了巨大的潜力，也带来了重大的伦理挑战。这份报告引发了关于这些强大工具的测试和部署，以及它们的能力是否被充分理解和控制的问题。当我们探索新的前沿领域时，我们必须警惕技术的负责任使用，确保它服务于人类，而不是破坏信任和安全。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Xbox caps cloud gaming at 15 hours a month for Game Pass subscribers
title.zh: Xbox 对 Game Pass 订阅者限制云游戏时间为每月 15 小时

summary.en: Xbox is implementing a monthly limit of 15 hours for cloud gaming on its Game Pass Ultimate subscription, citing rising operational costs. After exceeding this limit, subscribers will need to purchase additional play time. The company states these changes are necessary to continue investing in the service's...
summary.zh: Xbox 正在对其 Game Pass Ultimate 订阅服务实施每月 15 小时的云游戏时间限制，理由是运营成本不断上升。超出此限制后，订阅者需要购买额外的游戏时间。该公司表示，这些变化对于继续投资于服务的可靠性和性能是必要的。

body.en:
Xbox is introducing strict monthly time limits for Game Pass subscribers who stream games online through its cloud gaming service.

The changes, which come into effect in November, will see a subscriber to the £16.99 Ultimate monthly plan able to stream games for up to 15 hours a month - before having to purchase additional cloud play time.

Xbox said the limits were due to the rising cost of cloud gaming, and they would allow the firm to "continue to invest" in the service's "reliability and performance".

While some questioned , external whether the service was used by many to begin with, others called out , external the additional limits for subscribers.

Cloud gaming allows players to stream and play games online from a remote server using a phone, tablet or controller, rather than downloading and running it on a PC or console at home.

Premium users will get 10 hours, while those on the basic Essential tier will get five hours a month before they have to pay for extra time.

Xbox claimed just 4% of the people who use Games Pass - its Netflix-style subscription plan for games - use its cloud gaming service.

A recent Wall Street Journal article , external reported Game Pass has 30 million subscribers, which would leave the number of people affected by the cloud gaming changes at roughly 1.2 million.

"This is a pretty awful change, hopefully Xbox adds an extra zero on the end cause 15hrs is abysmal. 30 minutes a day, really?" posted one commenter on X , external .

Jez Corden of Windows Central told the BBC the announcement showed that "absolutely nothing is safe from the AI-driven component crisis," but he added it also highlighted "where Microsoft's priorities are".

"For them to continue to offer unlimited access to Microsoft Copilot [AI] for free but restrict paid cloud gaming in this way shows some contradiction," he added.

Xbox said in a blog post , external that from November, users would also be able to use the company's cloud gaming feature without subscribing to Game Pass, but by buying "cloud playtime hours" through the Xbox store.

The news comes as Asha Sharma, Xbox's chief executive, told the BBC in an exclusive recent interview that the company and the industry as a whole needed to "start to innovate on affordability and efficiency," amid a "crisis" in computing prices.

"As an industry, we're in the middle of 'Rampocalypse'. We're in the middle of people coming back from Covid and the patterns changing," she said.

"Rampocalypse" refers to the fact that the cost of a previously cheap hardware component, random access memory (Ram), has shot up in price with the expansion of compute-hungry data centres. Some people also call it "Ramageddon" .

Sharma added: "Within Xbox, we haven't been healthy. And so a lot of the reset that will...
body.zh: Xbox 正在为通过其云游戏服务在线播放游戏的 Game Pass 订阅者引入严格的每月时间限制。 这些变化将于 11 月生效，订阅价格为 16.99 英镑的 Ultimate 月度套餐的用户每月可以玩最多 15 小时的流媒体游戏，然后才需要购买额外的云游戏时间。 Xbox 表示，这些限制是由于云游戏成本不断上升，这将使该公司能够“继续投资”该服务的“可靠性和性能”。 虽然一些人质疑该服务是否被许多人一开始就使用，但另一些人则呼吁对订户进行额外的限制。 云游戏允许玩家使用手机、平板电脑或控制器从远程服务器在线传输和玩游戏，而不是在家里的 PC 或游戏机上下载和运行游戏。 高级用户将获得 10 小时的使用时间，而基本基本级别的用户每月将获得 5 小时的使用时间，然后需要支付额外的时间。 Xbox 声称，只有 4% 使用 Games Pass（其 Netflix 式游戏订阅计划）的人使用其云游戏服务。 《华尔街日报》最近的一篇文章称，Game Pass 拥有 3000 万订阅者，这将使受云游戏变化影响的人数约为 120 万。 “这是一个非常糟糕的改变，希望 Xbox 在最后添加一个额外的零，因为 15 小时太糟糕了。每天 30 分钟，真的吗？”在 X 上发表了一位评论者，external 。 Windows Central 的 Jez Corden 告诉 BBC，这一公告表明“绝对没有什么可以免受人工智能驱动的组件危机的影响”，但他补充说，这也强调了“微软的优先事项在哪里”。 “他们继续免费提供对 Microsoft Copilot [AI] 的无限制访问，但以这种方式限制付费云游戏，这表明存在一些矛盾，”他补充道。 Xbox 在对外博客文章中表示，从 11 月开始，用户也可以在不订阅 Game Pass 的情况下使用该公司的云游戏功能，而是通过 Xbox 商店购买“云游戏时间”。 这一消息发布之际，Xbox 首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马 (Asha Sharma) 在最近接受 BBC 独家采访时表示，在计算价格的“危机”中，该公司和整个行业需要“开始在可承受性和效率方面进行创新”。 “作为一个行业，我们正处于‘灾难’之中。我们正处于人们从新冠疫情中回归、模式发生变化的之中，”她说。 “Rampocalypse”指的是这样一个事实：随着计算密集型数据中心的扩张，以前便宜的硬件组件随机存取存储器 (Ram) 的价格已经飙升。有些人也称其为“拉米吉多顿”。 Sharma 补充道：“在 Xbox 内部，我们一直不太健康。因此，很多重置都会......

reflection.en: The rapid expansion of cloud gaming offers convenience, but as Xbox's announcement shows, the underlying costs can become unsustainable. This reminds us that not every technological possibility is wise or beneficial in the long run. We are called to discern which innovations truly serve human flourishing and which may lead to hidden burdens or unsustainable...
reflection.zh: 云游戏的快速发展提供了便利，但正如 Xbox 的公告所示，其潜在成本可能变得难以维持。这提醒我们，并非所有技术可能性在长远来看都是明智或有益的。我们被呼召去辨别哪些创新真正服务于人类的繁荣，哪些可能导致隐藏的负担或不可持续的做法。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Air conditioners are our best bet in the fight against extreme heat – whether we like it or not
title.zh: 空调是我们应对极端高温的最佳选择——无论我们是否喜欢

summary.en: Global AC demand will inevitably accelerate as the world continues to warm amid the climate crisis. Green campaigners against climate change have often framed the challenge as a problem of excess consumption, motivating calls to 'degrow' the economy and curb population. This perspective clashes with the reality of...
summary.zh: 随着全球变暖和气候危机持续，全球空调需求不可避免地加速增长。气候变化最激进的环保主义者长期以来都存在一个致命的缺陷：他们常常将挑战视为过度消费的问题，这促使人们呼吁“去增长”经济和控制人口。这种观点与日益增长的空调使用现实产生了尖锐的冲突，尤其是在极端高温期间。

body.en: Global AC demand will inevitably accelerate as the world continues to warm amid the climate crisis The greenest campaigners against climate change have long suffered from a crippling shortcoming: they too often frame the challenge as a problem of excess consumption. This motivates calls to “degrow” the economy and to curb the population . The claim is that humans consume too many resources, which in the context of climate change means too much energy. Nowhere has the tension between this proposition and reality become more palpable during this sweltering summer than in the conversation over air conditioning. Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着世界在气候危机中持续变暖，全球空调需求将不可避免地加速最环保的气候变化倡导者长期以来一直遭受着一个严重的缺点：他们经常将这一挑战视为过度消费的问题。这引发了“去增长”经济和控制人口的呼声。据称，人类消耗了太多的资源，在气候变化的背景下意味着太多的能源。在这个闷热的夏天，这一主张与现实之间的紧张关系在空调旁的谈话中最为明显。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As the planet warms, the demand for air conditioning surges, presenting a complex challenge for climate advocates. This reality prompts reflection on our relationship with the Earth. Psalm 24:1 reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it,' suggesting a divine mandate for stewardship over mere consumption.
reflection.zh: 随着地球变暖，对空调的需求激增，这给气候倡导者带来了复杂的挑战。这一现实促使我们反思与地球的关系。《诗篇》24:1提醒我们，“地和其中所充满的，都属于雅伟”，这暗示着神圣的托付是管理，而非仅仅消费。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Indigenous knowledge helps reveal the ties between reefs and mangroves
title.zh: 土著知识有助于揭示珊瑚礁与红树林之间的联系

summary.en: The Bardi Jawi and Oorany Rangers, along with Bardi Jawi Traditional Owners, have collaborated with the Australian Institute of Marine Science (AIMS) for ten years. Their work, focusing on mangrove and reef ecosystems and traditional fishing grounds, has been recognized in a scientific article, underscoring the value...
summary.zh: 过去十年，巴迪贾维和奥拉尼巡逻员以及巴迪贾维传统所有者一直与澳大利亚海洋科学研究所（AIMS）合作。他们的工作重点是红树林和珊瑚礁生态系统以及传统的渔场，并已在一篇科学文章中得到认可，这凸显了土著知识在生态研究中的价值。

body.en: In a recent scientific article in the journal Ocean & Coastal Management, alongside the list of scientist-authors were the Bardi Jawi and Oorany Rangers and the Bardi Jawi Traditional Owners. For the past decade, Bardi Jawi rangers and traditional owners have been working with the Australian Institute of Marine Science (AIMS) to study and protect their mangrove and reef ecosystems, as well as their traditional Indigenous fishing grounds. The Bardi Jawi, according to Phillip “Bibido” McCarthy, are a “Saltwater People” whose traditional diet revolves around healthy oceans. Their land, located in the Kimberley region of northwestern Australia, is of “red earth, blue ocean, and green mangroves,” Bibido, the 59-year-old coordinator of the Bardi Jawi men’s ranger program, tells Mongabay. Bardi Jawi Country forms part of the 95,000-hectare (235,000-acre) Bardi Jawi Indigenous Protected Area (declared in 2013 and administered by the Bardi Jawi) and the 204,000-hectare (504,000-acre) Bardi Jawi Gaarra Marine Park (established in 2022, with a zoning scheme that came into force in July 2026). Among the most important findings in the study was the interconnectedness between reef and mangrove ecosystems for sustaining fisheries — an aspect long recognized in Bardi Jawi traditional ecological knowledge. The overall project and its findings also guided the design of both the IPA and marine park. Cape Leveque on the Dampier Peninsula in Western Australia. Image by Marty Southwell via Unsplash. Goldlined rabbitfish (Siganus lineatus). Image by © Kristin Anderson via iNaturalist. CC BY-NC 4.0. Much scientific work in recent years has focused on…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 在《海洋与海岸管理》杂志最近发表的一篇科学文章中，与科学家作者名单一起列出的还有巴迪爪夷 (Bardi Jawi) 和奥兰尼护林员 (Oorany Rangers) 以及巴迪爪夷 (Bardi Jawi) 传统所有者。在过去的十年中，巴迪爪夷护林员和传统业主一直与澳大利亚海洋科学研究所 (AIMS) 合作，研究和保护他们的红树林和珊瑚礁生态系统以及传统的土著渔场。据菲利普·“比比多”·麦卡锡所说，巴迪爪夷人是“咸水民族”，他们的传统饮食以健康的海洋为中心。 59 岁的巴迪贾维男子护林员项目协调员比比多 (Bibido) 告诉 Mongabay，他们的土地位于澳大利亚西北部的金伯利地区，拥有“红色的土地、蓝色的海洋和绿色的红树林”。巴迪爪夷乡村是占地 95,000 公顷（235,000 英亩）的巴迪爪夷土著保护区（于 2013 年宣布，由巴迪爪夷人管理）和占地 204,000 公顷（504,000 英亩）的巴迪爪夷加拉海洋公园（成立于 2022 年，分区计划于 7 月生效）的一部分2026）。该研究中最重要的发现之一是珊瑚礁和红树林生态系统之间对于维持渔业的相互联系——这是巴迪爪夷传统生态知识中长期认识到的一个方面。整个项目及其研究结果也指导了 IPA 和海洋公园的设计。勒维克角 (Cape Leveque) 位于西澳大利亚州丹皮尔半岛 (Dampier Peninsula)。图片由 Marty Southwell 提供，来自 Unsplash。金线兔鱼（Siganus lineatus）。图片由 © Kristin Anderson 通过 iNaturalist 提供。 CC BY-NC 4.0。近年来许多科学工作都集中在……本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The Bardi Jawi people, calling themselves 'Saltwater People,' have a deep, generational understanding of their marine environment. Their decade-long collaboration with scientists shows that true wisdom about creation often comes from those who live closest to it, observing its intricate workings and passing down knowledge through tradition. This partnership...
reflection.zh: 自称为“咸水人”的巴迪贾维人对他们的海洋环境有着深刻的世代理解。他们与科学家长达十年的合作表明，关于造物的真正智慧往往来自于那些最贴近它的人，他们观察其错综复杂的运作并将知识通过传统传承下来。这种伙伴关系揭示了，当古老和现代的各种知识以谦卑和尊重的方式结合在一起时，雅伟的创造才能得到最好的理解。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: ‘Britain’s Yellowstone’: restoration project aims to take the greed out of land acquisition
title.zh: ‘英国的黄石公园’：修复项目旨在摒弃土地收购中的贪婪

summary.en: Investors in Emblehope Moor will receive financial returns, after which the land will be transferred to community or charity ownership. Located in a remote part of Northumberland, the 7,500-acre Emblehope Moor has been purchased by Restore, a nature restoration company, for £8.5 million, making it the largest...
summary.zh: 恩布尔霍普沼泽地的投资者将获得财务回报，之后该土地将转交给社区或慈善机构所有。恩布尔霍普沼泽地位于英格兰北部诺森伯兰郡一个偏远地区，占地7500英亩，已被自然修复公司Restore以850万英镑的价格收购，成为英格兰由单一所有者拥有的最大片连片野化区域。

body.en: Investors in Emblehope Moor will get their financial returns – and then it will be given to community or charity owners It is difficult to find the most remote place in England. There is no public transport, no roads and no sign of any human habitation. Online route finders mistakenly direct cars up a grassy track. But miles along gravel forest roads in the far north of Northumberland is the largest contiguous rewilding site under single ownership in the country. The vast glacial bowl of 7,500-acre Emblehope Moor has been bought for £8.5m by Restore , a nature restoration company that works with landowners across Britain. Continue reading...
body.zh: Emblehope Moor 的投资者将获得财务回报，然后将其捐赠给社区或慈善机构所有者。这是英格兰最偏远的地方。这里没有公共交通，没有道路，也没有任何人类居住的迹象。在线路线查找器错误地将汽车引导到草地轨道上。但是，沿着诺森伯兰郡最北部的碎石森林道路绵延数英里，是该国单一所有权下最大的连续野生动物保护区。 Restore 公司以 850 万英镑的价格买下了占地 7,500 英亩的巨大冰川碗，Restore 是一家与英国各地土地所有者合作的自然恢复公司。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The purchase of Emblehope Moor for nature restoration, with a plan for community or charitable ownership after financial returns, offers a hopeful model. It suggests a way to steward creation, recognizing its inherent goodness and value beyond mere financial gain, aligning with the biblical affirmation that all of creation is 'very good'.
reflection.zh: 恩布尔霍普沼泽地被收购用于自然修复，并计划在获得财务回报后将其转交给社区或慈善机构所有，这提供了一个充满希望的模式。它表明了一种管理受造界的方式，认识到其固有的美好和价值超越了单纯的经济利益，这与圣经中肯定所有受造物都“甚好”的宣告相符。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: El Niño-fuelled wildfires destroy precious Indonesian forests – in pictures
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺引发的野火摧毁了宝贵的印度尼西亚森林——图集

summary.en: Indonesian authorities intensify operations as fires continue to burn across Sumatra and Kalimantan, with haze spreading to Malaysia, Singapore and Philippines.
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚当局正在加紧行动，因为苏门答腊岛和加里曼丹岛的火灾仍在继续燃烧，烟雾已扩散到马来西亚、新加坡和菲律宾。

reflection.en: The fires raging across Sumatra and Kalimantan, exacerbated by El Niño, are a stark reminder of creation's vulnerability. The Apostle Paul speaks of all creation groaning in labor pains, awaiting its redemption. These fires, destroying precious forests, are a physical manifestation of that groaning, a cry from the earth itself.
reflection.zh: 厄尔尼诺加剧了苏门答腊岛和加里曼丹岛肆虐的火灾，这 starkly提醒我们受造物的脆弱。使徒保罗说，万物都在一同劳苦，盼望得赎。这些摧毁宝贵森林的大火，是那劳苦呻吟的真实写照，是大地本身的呼喊。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Possums in the roof, koalas in bed: study shows how animals resort to Australian homes after habitat loss
title.zh: 袋貂在屋顶，考拉在床上：研究显示动物在栖息地丧失后会涌入澳大利亚人的家中

summary.en: Microbats and wombats are among the most common species found in buildings, with some discovered in letter boxes or air conditioning systems. New research reveals how native animals are making themselves at home in human houses, with possums being the most frequent visitors, followed by microbats and wombats, based on...
summary.zh: 微蝙蝠和袋熊是建筑物中最常见的物种，有些被发现在邮箱或空调系统中。一项新研究揭示了本地动物如何在我们家中安家落户，根据十年的野生动物救援报告，袋貂是最常见的访客，其次是微蝙蝠和袋熊。

body.en: Microbats and wombats among the most common species found in buildings, with some discovered in letterboxes or air conditioning systems Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Possums in the roof, bats in the curtains and ducks on the balcony: new research has revealed how native animals are making themselves at home in our houses. Researchers have analysed a decade of wildlife rescue reports and found brushtail and ringtail possums make up half of all cases of animals in buildings, followed by microbats and bare-nosed wombats. Continue reading...
body.zh: 小蝙蝠和袋熊是建筑物中最常见的物种，其中一些在信箱或空调系统中发现。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 屋顶上的负鼠、窗帘上的蝙蝠和阳台上的鸭子：新的研究揭示了本土动物如何在我们的房子里安逸自在。研究人员分析了十年来的野生动物救援报告，发现刷尾负鼠和环尾负鼠占建筑物中所有动物病例的一半，其次是微型蝙蝠和裸鼻袋熊。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As human development encroaches on natural habitats, native animals like possums and wombats are increasingly seeking refuge in our homes. This phenomenon, while disruptive, points to the remarkable adaptability and resilience of creation. The intricate behaviors and survival instincts of these creatures serve as a testament to the wisdom and design...
reflection.zh: 随着人类发展侵占自然栖息地，袋貂和袋熊等本地动物越来越多地在我们家中寻求庇护。这种现象虽然会带来干扰，却也彰显了造物的惊人适应性和韧性。这些生物复杂的行为和生存本能，证明了自然界固有的智慧和设计，提醒我们造物主的杰作。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: ‘I could watch her for hours’: the woman who rescued a bee and created a buzz
title.zh: “我可以看她几个小时”：一位女士救了一只蜜蜂，引起轰动

summary.en: After bringing injured queen bee Phoebee home in July, Gilly McArthur expected her to die soon, but she is still active fifty-two days later. Phoebee was found with a broken wing by the side of the road in the blistering sun, and McArthur brought her home, expecting her to die within a day or so.
summary.zh: 在七月份将受伤的蜂后菲比带回家后，吉莉·麦克阿瑟本以为她很快就会死去，但五十二天后她仍然活跃着。菲比被发现时躺在路边，翅膀折断，在烈日下，麦克阿瑟把她带回家，本以为她一两天内就会死去。

body.en: After bringing injured queen Phoebee home in July, Gilly McArthur expected her soon to die, but she’s bumbling on Fifty-two days ago, Phoebee was lying by the side of a road in the blistering sun with a broken wing. Today, she’s clambering up the arm of Gilly McArthur, around the nape of her neck and disappearing into her hair. “I couldn’t leave her by the roadside,” McArthur says. “So I bought her home and made her a bed of flowers. I thought she’d be dead in a day or so.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 七月将受伤的菲比王后带回家后，吉莉·麦克阿瑟原以为她很快就会死去，但她却装模作样。 五十二天前，菲比在烈日下躺在路边，翅膀折断了。今天，她爬上吉莉·麦克阿瑟的手臂，绕过她的颈背，消失在她的头发里。 “我不能把她留在路边，”麦克阿瑟说。 “所以我买了她的家，给她做了一个花坛。我以为她一天左右就会死。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world often focused on grand gestures, the story of Gilly McArthur and the injured bee, Phoebee, highlights the profound impact of small acts of kindness. Even when faced with a creature seemingly destined for a swift end, compassion led to dedicated care, demonstrating that love and attention can bring life and hope where despair might otherwise...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常关注宏大举动的世界里，吉莉·麦克阿瑟和受伤的蜜蜂菲比的故事，凸显了微小善举的深远影响。即使面对一只似乎注定很快就会消亡的生物，怜悯之心也促使她悉心照料，这表明爱与关注能在本可能被绝望笼罩的地方带来生命和希望。...

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Why are they killing this beautiful fish?
title.zh: 为什么他们要杀死这种美丽的鱼？

summary.en: Lionfish are beautiful, venomous, and devastating to Caribbean reefs. In Honduras, divers are fighting back with homemade spears, hunting competitions, and by putting lionfish on restaurant menus. Watch the full film to meet the community fighting back against one of the Caribbean’s most destructive invasive species.
summary.zh: 狮子鱼美丽但有毒，并且对加勒比海的珊瑚礁造成了毁灭性的破坏。在洪都拉斯，潜水员们正用自制鱼叉、狩猎比赛以及将狮子鱼推上餐桌的方式进行反击。观看完整影片，认识这个社区如何对抗加勒比地区最具破坏性的入侵物种之一。

body.en:
Lionfish are beautiful, venomous and devastating Caribbean reefs. In Honduras, divers are fighting back with homemade spears, hunting competitions and by putting lionfish on restaurant menus.

Watch the full film to meet the community fighting back against one of the Caribbean’s most destructive invasive species.
body.zh: 狮子鱼是美丽、有毒且具有破坏性的加勒比珊瑚礁。在洪都拉斯，潜水员用自制的矛、狩猎比赛以及将狮子鱼列入餐馆菜单进行反击。 观看完整影片，了解社区对抗加勒比地区最具破坏性的入侵物种之一的斗争。

reflection.en: The vibrant beauty of the lionfish, even as it wreaks havoc on Caribbean reefs, speaks to the astonishing diversity and complexity of Yahweh’s creation. It is a stark reminder that even in the face of ecological disruption, the intricate systems of the natural world reflect a profound, underlying wisdom.
reflection.zh: 狮子鱼鲜艳的美丽，即使它在加勒比海的珊瑚礁上造成破坏，也体现了雅伟创造的惊人多样性和复杂性。它鲜明地提醒我们，即使面对生态的破坏，自然世界错综复杂的系统也反映了一种深刻的、根本的智慧。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Urban water quality pose challenges to low-income communities in Sri Lanka’s commercial capital
title.zh: 斯里兰卡首都低收入社区的水质面临挑战

summary.en: In Colombo, Sri Lanka, residents of low-income settlements like Nalin Kaluwitharana's are facing water quality challenges. Despite drought conditions and requests to conserve water, they rely on pipe-borne water for daily needs. Kaluwitharana continues to water his garden to keep it alive, even as utility tariffs...
summary.zh: 在斯里兰卡科伦坡，像纳林·卡卢维塔拉这样的低收入社区居民正面临水质挑战。尽管面临干旱并被要求节约用水，他们仍依赖自来水满足日常需求。卡卢维塔拉继续浇灌他的花园以保持其生机，即使水电费不断上涨，这凸显了水资源对这些社区生存和福祉的至关重要性。

body.en: COLOMBO — As part of his morning routine, Nalin Kaluwitharana from “Ranjan Wijerathnapura,” a low-income settlement in the heart of Colombo, waters his home garden before setting off to work. Like many others in his neighborhood, he works as a three-wheeler driver. “We obtain pipe-borne water provided by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB). In the wake of drought conditions, NWSDB has requested people to use water sparingly. But we need water for our daily needs and have no alternatives but to rely on tap water,” he told Mongabay. Despite increasing utility tariffs, he continues to water the plants to keep them green and his surroundings alive. Kaluwitharana and a majority of houses in this settlement do not have water storage facilities and are dependent on the state utility to obtain water directly from the water line. The routine water cuts and maintenance work disrupt the regular water supply, inconveniencing them. Linda Arulanantham is from the same neighborhood. “Immediately after a water cut, the water turns muddy. We use a water filter to make sure that the water we drink is clean,” she said. But every household doesn’t have a water filter system, and water safety in urban low-income settlements is often neglected. Community water supply schemes In Sri Lanka, community water supply schemes were established around the 1990s to provide safe drinking water to rural communities. Ananda Vijitha Kumara Mapa, director general at the Department of National Community Water Supply (DNCWS) told Mongabay that community water supply…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 科伦坡——来自科伦坡市中心低收入居住区“Ranjan Wijerathnapura”的纳林·卡鲁维萨拉纳 (Nalin Kaluwitharana) 在上班前给自家花园浇水，这是他早晨例行公事的一部分。和附近的许多人一样，他是一名三轮车司机。 “我们获得国家供水排水委员会（NWSDB）提供的管道水。在干旱之后，国家供水排水委员会要求人们节约用水。但我们需要水来满足日常需求，除了依靠自来水之外别无选择，”他告诉Mongabay。尽管水电费不断上涨，他仍继续给植物浇水，以保持植物的绿色和周围环境的活力。 Kaluwitharana 和该定居点的大多数房屋没有储水设施，只能依靠国家公用事业公司直接从供水管道取水。例行的停水和维护工作扰乱了正常供水，给他们带来不便。琳达·阿鲁兰南瑟姆 (Linda Arulanantham) 来自同一个社区。 “停水后，水立即变得浑浊。我们使用滤水器来确保我们饮用的水是干净的，”她说。但家家户户都没有水过滤系统，城市低收入住区的水安全往往被忽视。社区供水计划 在斯里兰卡，社区供水计划于 20 世纪 90 年代左右建立，旨在为农村社区提供安全饮用水。国家社区供水部 (DNCWS) 总干事阿南达·维吉塔·库马拉·马帕 (Ananda Vijitha Kumara Mapa) 告诉 Mongabay，社区供水……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The earth, in its vastness and complexity, is a testament to Yahweh's wisdom. From the intricate systems that provide water to the smallest garden, all creation reflects His provision. May we, like Nalin Kaluwitharana, find ways to care for the resources entrusted to us, recognizing their intrinsic value and the Creator's design.
reflection.zh: 大地广阔而复杂，是雅伟智慧的明证。从提供水源的精密系统到最小的花园，万物都反映着祂的供应。愿我们像纳林·卡卢维塔拉一样，找到方法来照管托付给我们的资源，认识到它们固有的价值和创造者的设计。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Satellite Images of Penguin Droppings Reveal Impact of Antarctic Warming
title.zh: 卫星图像中的企鹅粪便揭示了南极变暖的影响

summary.en: Satellite images of penguin droppings, visible from space due to their sheer volume, are being used by scientists to study Antarctic birds. An analysis of 30 years of these images reveals shifts in penguin diets linked to warming temperatures, with scientists even discovering new colonies by spotting the guano's...
summary.zh: 由于数量巨大，从太空中可见的企鹅粪便的卫星图像正被科学家用来研究南极鸟类。对这些图像长达30年的分析揭示了与气温变暖相关的企鹅饮食变化，科学家甚至通过发现粪便的特征来发现了新的企鹅栖息地。

body.en:
Penguin colonies are so large that their masses of excrement can be seen from space, offering scientists a useful means of studying the Antarctic birds. An analysis of 30 years of satellite images of penguin guano shows how the birds’ diets are shifting in response to warming.

Penguin droppings not only amass in huge volumes, but also stand out clearly against the white snow blanketing most of Antarctica. In 2024, scientists discovered four new colonies of emperor penguins by scanning satellite imagery for the signature brown streak left by their excrement.

For the new study, scientists analyzed subtle shifts in the color of Adélie penguin guano to track changes in their diet. First, they collected samples of guano and analyzed their color and contents, which allowed them to infer what penguins were eating by studying satellite imagery. Diets rich in krill — tiny, shrimplike crustaceans — lent guano a pink color.

Scanning roughly 4,000 images gathered between 1984 and 2013, scientists found that when sea ice is abundant, penguins eat more fish, and when sea ice is scarce, they rely more on krill.

With warming, sea ice is declining , hitting its lowest mark ever in 2023. And that is a problem for penguin chicks, which are typically heavier when fed fish than when fed krill, and are more likely to survive until adulthood. The new study , published in Current Biology , finds that in places where penguins are eating fewer fish, their numbers are dropping.

“Adélie penguins are an iconic species breeding all around the continent of Antarctica,” said coauthor Michael Polito, an ocean scientist at the University of California, Santa Cruz. “They act as a ‘canary in the coal mine,’ and our study illustrates how recent warming has disrupted the Antarctic marine food web they rely on to the detriment of many of their populations.”

Warming is not the only challenge facing penguins. At the same time that the loss of sea ice is cutting off access to fish, industrial supertrawlers are vacuuming up thousands of tons of Antarctic krill each year to feed a global market for dietary supplements and animal feed.

Scientists say both the retreat of sea ice and the loss of krill are driving declines of emperor penguins, which were listed as endangered by the International Union for Conservation of Nature earlier this year. A recent study found that krill fishery managers are not accounting for the compounding effects that krill fishing and warming are having on penguins.
body.zh: 企鹅群如此之大，以至于从太空中都可以看到它们大量的排泄物，这为科学家们提供了研究南极鸟类的有用手段。对 30 年来企鹅粪便卫星图像的分析显示了鸟类的饮食如何因气候变暖而发生变化。 企鹅的粪便不仅大量堆积，而且在覆盖南极洲大部分地区的白雪的衬托下显得格外引人注目。 2024 年，科学家通过扫描卫星图像寻找帝企鹅粪便留下的标志性棕色条纹，发现了四个新的帝企鹅群落。 在这项新研究中，科学家分析了阿德利企鹅鸟粪颜色的微妙变化，以追踪它们饮食的变化。首先，他们收集了鸟粪样本并分析了它们的颜色和含量，这使他们能够通过研究卫星图像来推断企鹅在吃什么。富含磷虾（一种微小的、像虾一样的甲壳类动物）的饮食使鸟粪呈粉红色。 科学家扫描了 1984 年至 2013 年间收集的大约 4000 张图像，发现当海冰丰富时，企鹅会吃更多的鱼，而当海冰稀缺时，它们会更多地依赖磷虾。 随着气候变暖，海冰正在减少，并在 2023 年达到有史以来的最低水平。这对企鹅幼崽来说是一个问题，它们在喂鱼时通常比喂磷虾时更重，并且更有可能存活到成年。这项发表在《当代生物学》上的新研究发现，在企鹅吃鱼较少的地方，它们的数量正在下降。 “阿德利企鹅是在南极大陆各地繁殖的标志性物种，”合著者、加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的海洋科学家迈克尔·波利托说。 “它们就像‘煤矿里的金丝雀’，我们的研究说明了最近的变暖如何扰乱了它们所依赖的南极海洋食物网，从而损害了它们的许多种群。” 变暖并不是企鹅面临的唯一挑战。与此同时，海冰的消失导致鱼类的获取途径被切断，工业超级拖网渔船每年捕捞数千吨南极磷虾，以满足全球膳食补充剂和动物饲料市场的需求。 科学家表示，海冰消退和磷虾减少正在导致帝企鹅数量减少，帝企鹅今年早些时候被国际自然保护联盟列为濒危物种。最近的一项研究发现，磷虾渔业管理者没有考虑磷虾捕捞和气候变暖对企鹅产生的复合影响。

reflection.en: The vastness of creation often holds clues to its own well-being. In Antarctica, the droppings of emperor penguins, visible from space, serve as an unexpected indicator of ecological change. This reminds us that Yahweh's wisdom is displayed throughout the natural world, inviting careful observation and care.
reflection.zh: 造物的浩瀚常常蕴藏着其自身福祉的线索。在南极洲，帝企鹅的粪便因其巨大的数量而从太空中可见，这成为了一个意想不到的生态变化指标。这提醒我们，雅伟的智慧彰显在整个自然界中，邀请我们仔细观察和关怀。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: A Surge of Marine Heat Waves Threatens to Scramble Ocean Life
title.zh: 海洋热浪激增，威胁要扰乱海洋生物

summary.en: Record-breaking marine heat waves, driven by climate change and a strengthening El Niño, are affecting oceans globally and severely disrupting marine life. Evidence suggests these events could cause long-lasting damage both on land and at sea. For example, an unusually large bloom of common octopuses has appeared off...
summary.zh: 受气候变化和不断增强的厄尔尼诺现象的推动，创纪录的海浪热浪正在席卷全球海洋，并对海洋生物造成严重破坏。越来越多的证据表明，这些事件可能对陆地和海洋都造成严重且持久的损害。例如，英国海岸出现了有史以来规模最大的普通章鱼幼体聚集现象，这与异常温暖的海水有关。

body.en:
Fueled by climate change and a strengthening El Niño, record-setting marine heat waves are gripping oceans worldwide and playing havoc with sea life. Mounting evidence from recent events suggests the damage could be severe and long-lasting, both onshore and off.

The common octopus is a warm water species that usually lives in the temperate waters of the Mediterranean. But last year, octopus larvae hitchhiked across the English Channel attached to plankton, resulting in an octopus bloom off England’s coast. This year, the bloom is the largest it’s been in 75 years.

Normally, octopus larvae that drift into cold waters die. But this year’s bloom, experts say, is the result of an unusually intense marine heat wave off of Devon and Cornwall, which raised water temperatures up to 9 degrees F above normal.

The change in species has been a boon for local fishers selling octopus into the lucrative European export market. (Octopus landings along the U.K.’s southwest coast were roughly 7,700 percent higher than usual in 2025.) And while the invasion has slashed the catch of scallops, lobster, and crab, it has boosted numbers of seals, conger eels, and dolphins, which eat octopus. The warming, in combination with abundant prey, has also drawn bluefin tuna and sharks to British waters for the first time in decades.

“It has completely shaken up the food chain,” said Bryce Stewart, a senior research fellow at the UK’s Marine Biological Association, which has been studying the phenomenon. While this kind of bloom has happened here before, he said, this one is different. During past surges, the return of cold water killed off the octopuses. This time, the octopuses aren’t dying. They’re reproducing.

Globally, marine heat waves — prolonged periods of unusually warm water — are becoming more common, more intense, longer lasting, and more widespread, experts say . This year, ocean heat is unusually severe, setting new temperature records . According to Global Climate Risks, a nonprofit created by scientists to publicize the effects of climate change, an estimated 82 percent of the world’s oceans are currently experiencing marine heat waves. Evidence from recent hot spells suggests the impacts on sea life could be profound and long-lasting.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

Ocean fevers can rearrange marine ecosystems, drive fish to move into deeper, colder layers of the sea, trigger coral bleaching, and cause widespread marine die-offs. They can increase the severity and number of algal blooms, which harm fish, shellfish, marine mammals, and birds. And they can cause extreme weather events, like tropical storms and hurricanes, and upend fishing and tourism.

body.zh: 在气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象加剧的推动下，创纪录的海洋热浪正在席卷全球海洋，对海洋生物造成严重破坏。最近发生的事件中越来越多的证据表明，无论是陆上还是海上，损害都可能是严重且持久的。 普通章鱼是温水物种，通常生活在地中海温带水域。但去年，章鱼幼虫附着在浮游生物上，搭便车穿越英吉利海峡，导致英格兰海岸出现章鱼大量繁​​殖。今年的花期是 75 年来规模最大的一次。 通常情况下，章鱼幼虫漂入冷水后就会死亡。但专家表示，今年的水华是德文郡和康沃尔郡异常强烈的海洋热浪造成的，导致水温比正常水平高出 9 华氏度。 物种的变化对于将章鱼销往利润丰厚的欧洲出口市场的当地渔民来说是一个福音。 （2025 年，英国西南海岸的章鱼登陆量比平时增加了大约 7,700%。）虽然入侵减少了扇贝、龙虾和螃蟹的捕获量，但以章鱼为食的海豹、海鳗和海豚的数量却增加了。气候变暖加上丰富的猎物，几十年来首次将蓝鳍金枪鱼和鲨鱼吸引到英国水域。 “它彻底撼动了食物链，”一直在研究这一现象的英国海洋生物协会高级研究员布莱斯·斯图尔特说。他说，虽然以前这里也发生过这种花，但这次不同。在过去的海潮中，冷水的回归导致章鱼死亡。这一次，章鱼没有死。他们正在繁殖。 专家表示，在全球范围内，海洋热浪（长时间异常温暖的海水）正变得更加常见、更加强烈、持续时间更长、范围更广。今年，海洋高温异常严重，创下了新的气温记录。据科学家创建、旨在宣传气候变化影响的非营利组织“全球气候风险”估计，目前世界上 82% 的海洋正在经历海洋热浪。最近的高温天气的证据表明，这对海洋生物的影响可能是深远而持久的。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 海洋热可以重新安排海洋生态系统，促使鱼类进入更深、更冷的海层，引发珊瑚白化，并导致广泛的海洋死亡。它们会增加藻华的严重程度和数量，从而危害鱼类、贝类、海洋哺乳动物和鸟类。它们还可能引发热带风暴和飓风等极端天气事件，并颠覆渔业和旅游业。 正式称为热浪，温度...

reflection.en: The prophet Isaiah spoke of creation's deep sigh, and Romans 8 echoes this, describing all of creation groaning as in labor pains. We see this groaning in the oceans, where rising temperatures disrupt ancient ecosystems and lead to unexpected blooms, like the octopus surge off England's coast. It is a reminder that the natural world, in its current state,...
reflection.zh: 先知以赛亚曾提到受造界的深沉叹息，罗马书第八章也呼应了这一点，将万物描述为一同叹息，如同经历生产之苦。我们在海洋中看到了这种叹息，不断升高的温度扰乱了古老的生态系统，并导致了意想不到的生物爆发，例如英国海岸的章鱼激增。这提醒我们，自然界在其现状下，也承载着影响所有生命的堕落的痕迹。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。
